local function nativeLookup(name)

 if value == nil then value = rawget(_G, name) end
 if value == nil then
  local ok, indexed = pcall(function() return env[name] end)
  if ok then value = indexed end
 end

local function escapePathSegment(value)
 value = tostring(value or "")
 value = string.gsub(value, "\\", "\\\\")
 value = string.gsub(value, "%.", "\\.")
 value = string.gsub(value, "~", "\\~")
 return value
local function splitInstancePath(path)
 local rawParts = {}
 local segment = {}
 local index = 1
 while index <= #path do
  local character = string.sub(path, index, index)
  if character == "\\" then
   table.insert(segment, character)
   if index < #path then
    table.insert(segment, string.sub(path, index + 1, index + 1))
    index += 2
   else
    index += 1
   end
  elseif character == "." then
   table.insert(rawParts, table.concat(segment))
   table.clear(segment)
   index += 1
  else
   table.insert(segment, character)
   index += 1
  end
 end
 table.insert(rawParts, table.concat(segment))
 local parts = {}
 for _, rawPart in ipairs(rawParts) do
  local name = {}
  local ordinal = nil
  index = 1
  while index <= #rawPart do
   local character = string.sub(rawPart, index, index)
   if character == "\\" then
    local nextCharacter = string.sub(rawPart, index + 1, index + 1)
    -- Responses show a name's invalid UTF-8 bytes as \xNN (literal backslashes are doubled by
    -- escapePathSegment), so decoding them lets those paths resolve back to the instance.
    local escapedByte = string.match(rawPart, "^x([89A-Fa-f]%x)", index + 1)
    if nextCharacter == "." or nextCharacter == "\\" or nextCharacter == "~" then
     table.insert(name, nextCharacter)
     index += 2
    elseif escapedByte then
     table.insert(name, string.char(tonumber(escapedByte, 16)))
     index += 4
    else
     table.insert(name, character)
     index += 1
    end
   elseif character == "~" then
    local suffix = string.sub(rawPart, index + 1)
    local parsedOrdinal = string.match(suffix, "^%d+$") and tonumber(suffix) or nil
    if parsedOrdinal and parsedOrdinal >= 2 then
     ordinal = parsedOrdinal
     break
    end
    table.insert(name, character)
    index += 1
   else
    table.insert(name, character)
    index += 1
   end
  end
  table.insert(parts, {name = table.concat(name), ordinal = ordinal})
 end
 return parts
local function escapedInstanceSegment(instance)
 local escaped = escapePathSegment(instance.Name)
 local parent = instance.Parent
 if not parent then return escaped end
 local first = parent:FindFirstChild(instance.Name)
 if first == instance or not first then return escaped end
 local ordinal = 0
 for _, sibling in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
  if sibling.Name == instance.Name then ordinal += 1 end
  if sibling == instance then
   return escaped .. "~" .. tostring(math.max(2, ordinal))
  end
 end
 return escaped
local function safePath(instance)
 if instance == game then return "game" end
 local parts = {}
 local current = instance
 local ok = pcall(function()
  while current and current ~= game do
   local segment = nil
   if current.Parent == game and current.Name ~= current.ClassName then
    -- resolvePath looks the first segment up with GetService, so a service the game renamed
    -- (some games rename Workspace) is reported by class name to keep paths round-trippable.
    local serviceOk, service = pcall(game.GetService, game, current.ClassName)
    if serviceOk and service == current then segment = escapePathSegment(current.ClassName) end
   end
   table.insert(parts, 1, segment or escapedInstanceSegment(current))
   current = current.Parent
  end
 end)
 if ok and #parts > 0 then return table.concat(parts, ".") end
 local fullNameOk, path = pcall(instance.GetFullName, instance)
 return fullNameOk and tostring(path) or tostring(instance)
local function getHandle(instance, allowNilParent)
 local existing = handleByInstance[instance]
 if existing and instanceByHandle[existing] == instance then
  if allowNilParent == true then nilCapableHandles[existing] = true end
  performanceStats.handles.reused += 1
  return existing
 end
 local debugId = getInstanceDebugId(instance)
 local debugHandle = debugId and handleByDebugId[debugId] or nil
 local debugInstance = debugHandle and instanceByHandle[debugHandle] or nil
 if debugInstance then
  local same = debugInstance == instance
  if not same and type(compareInstances) == "function" then
   local ok, result = pcall(compareInstances, debugInstance, instance)
   same = ok and result == true
  end
  if same then
   handleByInstance[instance] = debugHandle
   if allowNilParent == true then nilCapableHandles[debugHandle] = true end
   performanceStats.handles.reused += 1
   return debugHandle
  end
 end
 nextHandle += 1
 local handle = "i" .. tostring(runtimeState.generation) .. "_" .. tostring(nextHandle)
 handleByInstance[instance] = handle
 instanceByHandle[handle] = instance
 if debugId then
  handleByDebugId[debugId] = handle
  debugIdByHandle[handle] = debugId
 end
 if allowNilParent == true then nilCapableHandles[handle] = true end
 instanceHandleTail += 1
 instanceHandleOrder[instanceHandleTail] = handle
 while instanceHandleTail - instanceHandleHead + 1 > MAX_INSTANCE_HANDLES do
  local evictedHandle = instanceHandleOrder[instanceHandleHead]
  instanceHandleOrder[instanceHandleHead] = nil
  instanceHandleHead += 1
  local evictedInstance = instanceByHandle[evictedHandle]
  instanceByHandle[evictedHandle] = nil
  nilCapableHandles[evictedHandle] = nil
  local evictedDebugId = debugIdByHandle[evictedHandle]
  if evictedDebugId and handleByDebugId[evictedDebugId] == evictedHandle then handleByDebugId[evictedDebugId] = nil end
  debugIdByHandle[evictedHandle] = nil
  if evictedInstance and handleByInstance[evictedInstance] == evictedHandle then handleByInstance[evictedInstance] = nil end
 end
 if instanceHandleHead > 1024 and instanceHandleHead > instanceHandleTail / 2 then
  local compacted = {}
  for index = instanceHandleHead, instanceHandleTail do compacted[#compacted + 1] = instanceHandleOrder[index] end
  instanceHandleOrder = compacted
  instanceHandleHead = 1
  instanceHandleTail = #compacted
 end
 performanceStats.handles.created += 1
 return handle
local function resolveHandle(handle)
 local expectedPrefix = "i" .. tostring(runtimeState.generation) .. "_"
 local instance = type(handle) == "string" and instanceByHandle[handle] or nil
 local validHandle = type(handle) == "string"
  and string.sub(handle, 1, #expectedPrefix) == expectedPrefix
  and string.match(string.sub(handle, #expectedPrefix + 1), "^%d+$") ~= nil
 local live = typeof(instance) == "Instance"
 if live and instance ~= game then
  local parentOk, parent = pcall(function() return instance.Parent end)
  live = parentOk and (parent ~= nil or nilCapableHandles[handle] == true)
 end
 if not validHandle or not live then
  if type(handle) == "string" then
   instanceByHandle[handle] = nil
   nilCapableHandles[handle] = nil
   local debugId = debugIdByHandle[handle]
   if debugId and handleByDebugId[debugId] == handle then handleByDebugId[debugId] = nil end
   debugIdByHandle[handle] = nil
  end
  performanceStats.handles.stale += 1
  error("STALE_INSTANCE_HANDLE:" .. tostring(handle))
 end
 performanceStats.handles.resolved += 1
 return instance
local function instanceSummary(instance)
 local className = "Instance"
 local name = "?"
 pcall(function()
  className = instance.ClassName
  name = instance.Name
 end)
 local parent = nil
 local parentOk = pcall(function() parent = instance.Parent end)
 local unparented = instance ~= game and parentOk and parent == nil
 local summary = {
  type = "Instance",
  handle = getHandle(instance, unparented),
  name = name,
  className = className,
  parented = not unparented
 if not unparented then summary.path = safePath(instance) end
 return summary
local function unparentedInstanceSummary(instance)
 local summary = instanceSummary(instance)
 summary.path = nil
 summary.parented = false
 summary.handle = getHandle(instance, true)
 return summary
-- FLOW_SAFE_VALUE_BEGIN
local utf8Len = type(utf8) == "table" and utf8.len or nil
-- Byte width of the valid multi-byte UTF-8 character starting at position, or nil.
local function utf8MultibyteWidth(value, position)
 local byte = string.byte(value, position)
 if not byte or byte < 192 or not utf8Len or not utf8Len(value, position, position) then return nil end
 return byte >= 240 and 4 or byte >= 224 and 3 or 2
local function utf8SafePrefix(value, limit)
 local cut = math.min(#value, math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(limit) or 0)))
 if cut >= #value then return value end
 -- Move the cut back to the start of a valid character it would split. A character is at most
 -- 4 bytes, so only the last 3 bytes can start one; runs of stray continuation bytes in invalid
 -- data are not walked back over, which would otherwise collapse the prefix to nothing.
 for position = cut, math.max(1, cut - 2), -1 do
  local byte = string.byte(value, position)
  if byte < 128 or byte >= 192 then
   local width = utf8MultibyteWidth(value, position)
   if width and position + width - 1 > cut then cut = position - 1 end
   break
  end
 end
 return string.sub(value, 1, cut)
local function utf8SafeSlice(value, offset, limit)
 value = tostring(value or "")
 local requestedOffset = math.max(0, math.min(#value, math.floor(tonumber(offset) or 0)))
 local start = requestedOffset + 1
 -- An offset inside a valid character moves to the end of that character. Stray continuation
 -- bytes are kept, so paging through invalid data never silently drops bytes.
 for position = requestedOffset, math.max(1, requestedOffset - 2), -1 do
  local byte = string.byte(value, position)
  if byte < 128 or byte >= 192 then
   local width = utf8MultibyteWidth(value, position)
   if width and position + width > start then start = position + width end
   break
  end
 end
 local actualOffset = start - 1
 return utf8SafePrefix(string.sub(value, start), limit), actualOffset
-- Escapes bytes that are not valid UTF-8 as \xNN. Instance names, script sources and other
-- game-controlled strings can hold broken sequences (for example a name cut off mid-emoji),
-- and HttpService:JSONEncode rejects those, which would drop the whole command response.
-- Returns at most maxBytes of text, never splitting a character or an escape, and the number
-- of input bytes that text covers.
local function sanitizeUtf8(value, maxBytes)
 maxBytes = maxBytes or #value * 4
 if not utf8Len or utf8Len(value) then
  local prefix = utf8SafePrefix(value, maxBytes)
  return prefix, #prefix
 end
 local chunks = {}
 local used = 0
 local index = 1
 while index <= #value do
  local length, badAt = utf8Len(value, index)
  local runEnd = length and #value or (badAt or index) - 1
  if runEnd >= index then
   local run = utf8SafePrefix(string.sub(value, index, runEnd), maxBytes - used)
   table.insert(chunks, run)
   used += #run
   index += #run
   if index <= runEnd then break end
  end
  if length or used + 4 > maxBytes then break end
  table.insert(chunks, string.format("\\x%02X", string.byte(value, index)))
  used += 4
  index += 1
 end
 return table.concat(chunks), index - 1
-- Turns \xNN escapes (as produced by sanitizeUtf8, always 0x80 or above) back into raw bytes,
-- so text copied from a response, like a search query, matches the original name.
local function decodeByteEscapes(value)
 return (string.gsub(value, "\\x([89A-Fa-f]%x)", function(hex) return string.char(tonumber(hex, 16)) end))
local function truncate(value, limit)
 value = tostring(value or "")
 local text, covered = sanitizeUtf8(utf8SafePrefix(value, limit), limit)
 if covered >= #value then return text end
 return text .. "\u{2026}(+" .. tostring(#value - covered) .. " bytes)"
local function toHex(value, maxChars)
 local byteLimit = math.min(#value, math.floor(math.max(0, tonumber(maxChars) or 0) / 2))
 local chunks = table.create(byteLimit)
 for index = 1, byteLimit do
  chunks[index] = string.format("%02x", string.byte(value, index))
 end
 return table.concat(chunks), byteLimit < #value
local function safeTableKey(key)
 if typeof(key) == "string" then return truncate(key, 256) end
 if typeof(key) == "number" or typeof(key) == "boolean" then return tostring(key) end
 return "<" .. typeof(key) .. "-key>"
local function safeValue(value, depth, seen, stringLimit, budget, maxEntries, maxDepth)
 depth = depth or 0
 seen = seen or {}
 budget = budget or {remaining = MAX_SERIALIZE_TOTAL_ENTRIES}
 budget.bytes = budget.bytes or 262144
 budget.visited = (budget.visited or 0) + 1
 budget.clock = budget.clock or os.clock
 budget.sliceStartedAt = budget.sliceStartedAt or budget.clock()
 if budget.visited % 32 == 0 and budget.clock() - budget.sliceStartedAt >= 0.001 then
  if budget.yield then budget.yield() elseif task and task.wait then task.wait() end
  budget.sliceStartedAt = budget.clock()
 end
 if budget.bytes <= 0 then budget.exhausted = true; return "<byte-budget>" end
 budget.bytes -= 16
 stringLimit = tonumber(stringLimit) or MAX_SERIALIZE_STRING
 maxEntries = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(maxEntries) or MAX_SERIALIZE_ENTRIES))
 maxDepth = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(maxDepth) or MAX_SERIALIZE_DEPTH))
 local kind = typeof(value)
 if kind == "nil" or kind == "boolean" then return value end
 if kind == "number" then
  if value ~= value then return "<nan>" end
  if value == math.huge then return "<infinity>" end
  if value == -math.huge then return "<-infinity>" end
  return value
 end
 if kind == "string" then
  local text = truncate(value, math.max(0, math.min(stringLimit, budget.bytes)))
  budget.bytes -= #text
  return text
 end
 if kind == "Instance" then return safeValue(instanceSummary(value), depth + 1, seen, stringLimit, budget, maxEntries, maxDepth) end
 if kind == "Vector2" or kind == "Vector3" or kind == "CFrame" or kind == "Color3"
  or kind == "UDim" or kind == "UDim2" or kind == "BrickColor" or kind == "EnumItem"
 then
  return {type = kind, value = tostring(value)}
 end
 if kind == "function" then return "<function>" end
 if kind == "thread" then return "<thread>" end
 if kind ~= "table" then return "<" .. kind .. ":" .. truncate(value, 200) .. ">" end
 if depth >= maxDepth then return "<max-depth>" end
 if seen[value] then return "<cycle>" end
 seen[value] = true
 local result = {}
 local arrayLength = rawlen(value)
 local isArray = arrayLength > 0
 if isArray then
  local inspected = 0
  for key in next, value do
   inspected += 1
   if typeof(key) ~= "number" or key < 1 or key > arrayLength or key % 1 ~= 0 then
    isArray = false
    break
   end
    if inspected > maxEntries then break end
  end
 end
 if isArray then
  local count = math.min(arrayLength, maxEntries, budget.remaining)
  local emitted = 0
  for index = 1, count do
   if budget.bytes <= 0 then break end
   emitted = index
   budget.remaining -= 1
   result[index] = safeValue(rawget(value, index), depth + 1, seen, stringLimit, budget, maxEntries, maxDepth)
  end
  if arrayLength > emitted then
   result[emitted + 1] = "<" .. tostring(arrayLength - emitted) .. " omitted>"
  end
 else
  local count = 0
  local truncated = false
  for key, entry in next, value do
   if count >= maxEntries or budget.remaining <= 0 or budget.bytes <= 0 then
    truncated = true
    break
   end
   count += 1
   budget.remaining -= 1
   local safeKey = safeTableKey(key)
   budget.bytes -= #safeKey
   local uniqueKey = safeKey
   local collision = count
   while result[uniqueKey] ~= nil do
    collision += 1
    uniqueKey = safeKey .. "#" .. tostring(collision)
   end
   result[uniqueKey] = safeValue(entry, depth + 1, seen, stringLimit, budget, maxEntries, maxDepth)
  end
  if truncated then result.__omitted = "additional entries" end
 end
 seen[value] = nil
 return result
-- FLOW_SAFE_VALUE_END
local function countEntries(value)
 local count = 0
 for _ in next, value do count += 1 end
 return count
-- FLOW_RING_BUFFER_BEGIN
local function newRingBuffer(capacity)
 return {
  capacity = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(capacity) or 1)),
  entries = {},
  head = 1,
  count = 0
local function ringPush(buffer, value)
 if buffer.count < buffer.capacity then
  local index = ((buffer.head + buffer.count - 1) % buffer.capacity) + 1
  buffer.entries[index] = value
  buffer.count += 1
 else
  buffer.entries[buffer.head] = value
  buffer.head = (buffer.head % buffer.capacity) + 1
 end
local function ringGet(buffer, chronologicalIndex)
 chronologicalIndex = math.floor(tonumber(chronologicalIndex) or 0)
 if chronologicalIndex < 1 or chronologicalIndex > buffer.count then return nil end
 local index = ((buffer.head + chronologicalIndex - 2) % buffer.capacity) + 1
 return buffer.entries[index]
local function ringResize(buffer, capacity)
 local resized = newRingBuffer(capacity)
 local first = math.max(1, buffer.count - resized.capacity + 1)
 for index = first, buffer.count do ringPush(resized, ringGet(buffer, index)) end
 return resized
local function ringClear(buffer)
 table.clear(buffer.entries)
 buffer.head = 1
 buffer.count = 0
-- FLOW_RING_BUFFER_END
local function resolvePath(path)
 if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" or path == "game" then return game end
 if path == "workspace" or path == "Workspace" or path == "game.Workspace" then return workspace end
 local parts = splitInstancePath(path)
 local index = 1
 if parts[1] and parts[1].name == "game" and not parts[1].ordinal then index = 2 end
 local firstPart = parts[index]
 local first = firstPart and firstPart.name
 local currentInstance = game
 if first and first ~= "" then
  local ok, service = pcall(game.GetService, game, first)
  currentInstance = ok and service or game:FindFirstChild(first)
 index += 1
 end
 while currentInstance and index <= #parts do
  local part = parts[index]
  if currentInstance == Players and part.name == "LocalPlayer" and not part.ordinal then
   currentInstance = Players.LocalPlayer
  elseif part.ordinal then
   local ordinal = 0
   local resolved = nil
   for _, child in ipairs(currentInstance:GetChildren()) do
    if child.Name == part.name then ordinal += 1 end
    if ordinal == part.ordinal then
     resolved = child
     break
    end
   end
   currentInstance = resolved
  else
   currentInstance = currentInstance:FindFirstChild(part.name)
  end
  index += 1
 end
 return currentInstance
local function resolveInstance(payload)
 payload = type(payload) == "table" and payload or {}
 if payload.handle ~= nil then return resolveHandle(payload.handle) end
 local instance = resolvePath(payload.path or payload.root)
 if not instance then error("instance not found: " .. tostring(payload.path or payload.root)) end
 return instance
local function getChildren(instance)
 local ok, children = pcall(instance.GetChildren, instance)
 return ok and children or {}
local function clamp(value, minimum, maximum, fallback)
 value = tonumber(value) or fallback
 return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, value))
-- FLOW_COOPERATIVE_BUDGET_BEGIN
local traversalStats = {scanned = 0, yields = 0}
local function newTraversalRuntime(clockFn, yieldFn, budgetSeconds)
 local runtime = {
  clock = clockFn or os.clock,
  yield = yieldFn or function() task.wait() end,
  budgetSeconds = math.max(0.0005, tonumber(budgetSeconds) or 0.002),
  scanned = 0,
  yields = 0
 runtime.sliceStartedAt = runtime.clock()
 return runtime
local function cooperativeCheckpoint(runtime, scanned)
 scanned = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(scanned) or 0))
 runtime.scanned += scanned
 traversalStats.scanned += scanned
 local now = runtime.clock()
 if now - runtime.sliceStartedAt < runtime.budgetSeconds then return false end
 runtime.yield()
 runtime.yields += 1
 traversalStats.yields += 1
 runtime.sliceStartedAt = runtime.clock()
 return true
-- FLOW_COOPERATIVE_BUDGET_END
local function buildTree(root, maxDepth, maxChildren)
 local total = 0
 local truncated = false
 local runtime = newTraversalRuntime()
 local function visit(instance, depth)
  total += 1
  cooperativeCheckpoint(runtime, 1)
  local node = instanceSummary(instance)
  local children = getChildren(instance)
  if depth >= maxDepth or total >= MAX_TREE_NODES then
   if #children > 0 then
    node.omittedChildren = #children
    truncated = true
   end
   if total >= MAX_TREE_NODES then truncated = true end
   return node
  end
  node.children = {}
  local count = math.min(#children, maxChildren, MAX_TREE_NODES - total)
  for i = 1, count do
   table.insert(node.children, visit(children[i], depth + 1))
   if total >= MAX_TREE_NODES then break end
  end
  if #children > count then
   node.omittedChildren = #children - count
   truncated = true
  end
  return node
 end
 return visit(root, 0), total, truncated
local function walk(root, maxDepth, callback)
 local queue = {{instance = root, depth = 0}}
 local runtime = newTraversalRuntime()
 local cursor = 1
 local scanned = 0
 local queueTruncated = false
 while cursor <= #queue and scanned < MAX_SEARCH_SCAN do
  local item = queue[cursor]
  cursor += 1
  scanned += 1
  cooperativeCheckpoint(runtime, 1)
  if callback(item.instance, item.depth, scanned) == false then break end
  if item.depth < maxDepth then
   for _, child in ipairs(getChildren(item.instance)) do
    if #queue < MAX_SEARCH_SCAN then
     table.insert(queue, {instance = child, depth = item.depth + 1})
    else
     queueTruncated = true
     break
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return scanned, queueTruncated
local commonProperties = {
 "Name", "ClassName", "Parent", "Archivable", "Position", "CFrame", "Size", "Anchored",
 "CanCollide", "Transparency", "Visible", "Enabled", "Text", "Value", "Health", "MaxHealth",
 "WalkSpeed", "JumpPower", "UserId", "DisplayName"
local function readProperties(instance, requested)
 local names = type(requested) == "table" and requested or commonProperties
 local result = {}
 local failures = {}
 local limit = math.min(#names, 100)
 for i = 1, limit do
  local name = tostring(names[i])
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[name] end)
  if ok then result[name] = safeValue(value) else failures[name] = truncate(value, 300) end
 end
 return result, failures
-- FLOW_CONSOLE_BUFFER_BEGIN
local consoleEntries = newRingBuffer(500)
local consoleCapture = {connection = nil, generation = 0, expiresAt = nil}
local consoleStats = {
 received = 0,
 retained = 0,
 collapsed = 0,
 suppressed = 0,
 windowStartedAt = 0,
 windowAccepted = 0
local CONSOLE_UNIQUE_PER_SECOND = 200
local function pushConsoleEntry(message, messageType, now)
 now = tonumber(now) or os.clock()
 local level = tostring(messageType)
 local text = truncate(message, MAX_SERIALIZE_STRING)
 consoleStats.received += 1
 local newest = ringGet(consoleEntries, consoleEntries.count)
 if newest and newest.level == level and newest.message == text then
  newest.lastAt = now
  newest.at = now
  newest.repeatCount = (tonumber(newest.repeatCount) or 1) + 1
  consoleStats.collapsed += 1
  return true
 end
 if now - consoleStats.windowStartedAt >= 1 or now < consoleStats.windowStartedAt then
  consoleStats.windowStartedAt = now
  consoleStats.windowAccepted = 0
 end
 if consoleStats.windowAccepted >= CONSOLE_UNIQUE_PER_SECOND then
  consoleStats.suppressed += 1
  return false
 end
 consoleStats.windowAccepted += 1
 consoleStats.retained += 1
 ringPush(consoleEntries, {
  at = now,
  firstAt = now,
  lastAt = now,
  repeatCount = 1,
  level = level,
  message = text
 return true
-- FLOW_CONSOLE_BUFFER_END
function consoleCapture.stop()
 consoleCapture.generation += 1
 if consoleCapture.connection then pcall(consoleCapture.connection.Disconnect, consoleCapture.connection) end
 consoleCapture.connection = nil
 consoleCapture.expiresAt = nil
function consoleCapture.start(durationMs)
 local duration = clamp(durationMs, 1000, 60000, 10000)
 if not consoleCapture.connection then
  local logService = game:GetService("LogService")
  consoleCapture.connection = logService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message, messageType)
   pushConsoleEntry(message, messageType, os.clock())
  end)
 end
 consoleCapture.generation += 1
 local lease = consoleCapture.generation
 consoleCapture.expiresAt = os.clock() + duration / 1000
 task.delay(duration / 1000, function()
  if current() and consoleCapture.generation == lease then consoleCapture.stop() end
 end)
 return duration
local function disconnectWatcher(watcher)
 if type(watcher) == "table" then
  for _, connection in pairs(watcher) do
   if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
  end
 elseif watcher then
  pcall(function() watcher:Disconnect() end)
 end
local watchers = {}
local watchEvents = newRingBuffer(300)
local nextWatchId = 0
-- FLOW_REMOTE_SPY_QUEUE_BEGIN
local function newCaptureQueue(capacity)
 return {
  capacity = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(capacity) or 1)),
  entries = {},
  head = 1,
  count = 0,
  accepted = 0,
  dropped = 0,
  highWater = 0
local function captureQueuePush(queue, value)
 if queue.count >= queue.capacity then
  queue.dropped += 1
  return false
 end
 local index = ((queue.head + queue.count - 1) % queue.capacity) + 1
 queue.entries[index] = value
 queue.count += 1
 queue.accepted += 1
 queue.highWater = math.max(queue.highWater, queue.count)
 return true
local function captureQueuePop(queue)
 if queue.count <= 0 then return nil end
 local value = queue.entries[queue.head]
 queue.entries[queue.head] = nil
 queue.head = (queue.head % queue.capacity) + 1
 queue.count -= 1
 return value
local function captureQueueClear(queue)
 table.clear(queue.entries)
 queue.head = 1
 queue.count = 0
local function scheduleCaptureDrain(state, deferFunction, drainFunction)
 if state.drainScheduled then return false end
 state.drainScheduled = true
 deferFunction(function()
  state.workerRuns = (tonumber(state.workerRuns) or 0) + 1
  state.activeWorkers = (tonumber(state.activeWorkers) or 0) + 1
  state.workerHighWater = math.max(tonumber(state.workerHighWater) or 0, state.activeWorkers)
  local ok, hasMore = pcall(drainFunction)
  state.activeWorkers = math.max(0, (tonumber(state.activeWorkers) or 1) - 1)
  state.drainScheduled = false
  if not ok then
   state.lastCaptureError = tostring(hasMore)
  elseif hasMore == true then
   scheduleCaptureDrain(state, deferFunction, drainFunction)
  end
 end)
 return true
-- FLOW_REMOTE_SPY_QUEUE_END

  installMethods = normalizedProfile == "full" and captureDirectCalls == true

 local methodCoverage = {}
 local methodErrors = {}
 if plan.installMethods then
  methodsInstalled, methodCoverage, methodErrors = installMethods()
 end

 if backend == "method" and liveState.captureDirectCalls ~= true then return false end
 return true

local function remoteRuleKey(method, className, path)
 return method .. "|" .. className .. "|" .. path
local remoteMethods = {
 FireServer = true,
 InvokeServer = true,
 Fire = true,
 Invoke = true,
 OnClientEvent = true
local function remoteClassName(remote)
 local className = "Instance"
 pcall(function() className = remote.ClassName end)
 return className
local function outgoingClassAllowed(liveState, className, method)
 if type(liveState.methods) == "table" and liveState.methods[method] ~= true then return false end
 if className == "RemoteEvent" or className == "UnreliableRemoteEvent" then return method == "FireServer" end
 if className == "RemoteFunction" then return method == "InvokeServer" end
 if liveState.includeBindables and className == "BindableEvent" then return method == "Fire" end
 if liveState.includeBindables and className == "BindableFunction" then return method == "Invoke" end
 return false
-- FLOW_REMOTE_PACKED_VALUES_BEGIN
function remoteLimits.boundedPacked(packed, firstIndex)
 firstIndex = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(firstIndex) or 1))
 local packedCount = type(packed) == "table" and math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(packed.n) or 0)) or 0
 local total = math.max(0, packedCount - firstIndex + 1)
 local count = math.min(total, remoteLimits.captureValues)
 local result = {n = count, total = total}
 for offset = 0, count - 1 do result[offset + 1] = packed[firstIndex + offset] end
 return result
-- FLOW_REMOTE_PACKED_VALUES_END
local function valueToLuau(value, depth, seen, budget)
 depth = depth or 0
 seen = seen or {}
 budget = budget or {remaining = 100}
 local kind = typeof(value)
 if kind == "nil" then return "nil" end
 if kind == "boolean" then return tostring(value) end
 if kind == "number" then
  if value ~= value then return "(0/0)" end
  if value == math.huge then return "math.huge" end
  if value == -math.huge then return "-math.huge" end
  return tostring(value)
 end
 if kind == "string" then return string.format("%q", truncate(value, 1000)) end
 if kind == "Instance" then
  local parentOk, parent = pcall(function() return value.Parent end)
  if not parentOk or parent == nil then return "nil" end
  return "assert((getgenv and getgenv() or _G)[" .. string.format("%q", PRIVATE_STATE_KEY)
   .. "].resolveInstancePath(" .. string.format("%q", safePath(value)) .. "))"
 end
 if kind == "Vector2" then return "Vector2.new(" .. tostring(value.X) .. "," .. tostring(value.Y) .. ")" end
 if kind == "Vector3" then return "Vector3.new(" .. tostring(value.X) .. "," .. tostring(value.Y) .. "," .. tostring(value.Z) .. ")" end
 if kind == "Color3" then return "Color3.new(" .. tostring(value.R) .. "," .. tostring(value.G) .. "," .. tostring(value.B) .. ")" end
 if kind == "BrickColor" then return "BrickColor.new(" .. tostring(value.Number) .. ")" end
 if kind == "EnumItem" then return tostring(value) end
 if kind ~= "table" or depth >= 3 or seen[value] or budget.remaining <= 0 then return "nil" end
 seen[value] = true
 local fields = {}
 for key, entry in pairs(value) do
  if #fields >= 30 or budget.remaining <= 0 then break end
  budget.remaining -= 1
  fields[#fields + 1] = "[" .. valueToLuau(key, depth + 1, seen, budget) .. "]=" .. valueToLuau(entry, depth + 1, seen, budget)
 end
 seen[value] = nil
 return "{" .. table.concat(fields, ",") .. "}"
function remoteLimits.serializePacked(packed)
 local values = {}
 local retained = type(packed) == "table" and math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(packed.n) or 0)) or 0
 local total = type(packed) == "table" and math.max(retained, math.floor(tonumber(packed.total) or retained)) or 0
 local maximum = math.min(retained, remoteLimits.captureValues)
 local budget = {remaining = remoteLimits.captureEntries}
 local serialized = 0
 for index = 1, maximum do
  if budget.remaining <= 0 then break end
  values[index] = safeValue(packed[index], 0, nil, remoteLimits.captureString, budget)
  serialized = index
 end
 return values, {
  entries = remoteLimits.captureEntries - budget.remaining,
  budgetExhausted = serialized < maximum,
  omitted = math.max(0, total - serialized)
local function buildRemoteReplaySource(record, path)
 if record.direction == "inbound" or record.allowReplay ~= true then return nil end
 local arguments = {}
 local retained = type(record.packed) == "table" and math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(record.packed.n) or 0)) or 0
 local total = type(record.packed) == "table" and math.max(retained, math.floor(tonumber(record.packed.total) or retained)) or 0
 local maximum = math.min(retained, remoteLimits.captureValues)
 local budget = {remaining = remoteLimits.replayEntries}
 local serialized = 0
 for index = 1, maximum do
  if budget.remaining <= 0 then break end
  arguments[index] = valueToLuau(record.packed[index], 0, nil, budget)
  serialized = index
 end
 local source = "local e=getgenv and getgenv() or _G;local s=assert(e[" .. string.format("%q", PRIVATE_STATE_KEY)
  .. "],\"connector unavailable\");local r=assert(s.resolveInstancePath("
  .. string.format("%q", path)
  .. "),\"remote unavailable\");return r:"
  .. record.method
  .. "("
  .. table.concat(arguments, ",")
  .. ")"
 return truncate(source, MAX_RESULT_STRING), {
  entries = remoteLimits.replayEntries - budget.remaining,
  budgetExhausted = serialized < maximum,
  omitted = math.max(0, total - serialized)
local function enqueueRemoteCapture(liveState, record)
 if type(liveState) ~= "table" or liveState.captureGeneration ~= record.captureGeneration then return false end
 local sequence = liveState.nextSequence + 1
 record.sequence = sequence
 if not captureQueuePush(liveState.queue, record) then return false end
 liveState.nextSequence = sequence
 scheduleCaptureDrain(liveState, task.defer, function()
  local started = os.clock()
  while liveState.queue.count > 0 do
   local queued = captureQueuePop(liveState.queue)
   if queued then
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
     if liveState.captureGeneration ~= queued.captureGeneration then return end
     local remote = queued.remote
     local path = safePath(remote)
     local className = queued.className or remoteClassName(remote)
     local key = remoteRuleKey(queued.method, className, path)
     liveState.identityByInstance[remote] = {path = path, className = className, key = key}
     local args, argumentSerialization = remoteLimits.serializePacked(queued.packed)
     local returns = nil
     local returnSerialization = nil
     if type(queued.returned) == "table" then
      returns, returnSerialization = remoteLimits.serializePacked(queued.returned)
     end
     local callingScript = nil
     if typeof(queued.callingScript) == "Instance" then
      callingScript = instanceSummary(queued.callingScript)
     elseif queued.callingScript ~= nil then
      callingScript = truncate(queued.callingScript, 500)
     end
     if liveState.captureGeneration ~= queued.captureGeneration then return end
     local replaySource, replaySerialization = buildRemoteReplaySource(queued, path)
     local budgetExhausted = argumentSerialization.budgetExhausted
      or (type(returnSerialization) == "table" and returnSerialization.budgetExhausted == true)
      or (type(replaySerialization) == "table" and replaySerialization.budgetExhausted == true)
     if budgetExhausted then liveState.serializationBudgetExhaustions += 1 end
     ringPush(liveState.logs, {
      sequence = queued.sequence,
      at = queued.at,
      direction = queued.direction or "outbound",
      key = key,
      method = queued.method,
      className = className,
      path = path,
      handle = typeof(remote) == "Instance" and getHandle(remote) or nil,
      blocked = queued.blocked,
      fromExecutor = queued.fromExecutor,
      backend = queued.backend,
      args = args,
      omittedArgs = argumentSerialization.omitted,
      returns = returns,
      omittedReturns = type(returnSerialization) == "table" and returnSerialization.omitted or nil,
      durationSeconds = queued.durationSeconds,
      invocationError = queued.invocationError,
      callingScript = callingScript,
      replaySource = replaySource,
      serialization = {
       argumentEntries = argumentSerialization.entries,
       argumentBudgetExhausted = argumentSerialization.budgetExhausted,
       returnEntries = type(returnSerialization) == "table" and returnSerialization.entries or nil,
       returnBudgetExhausted = type(returnSerialization) == "table" and returnSerialization.budgetExhausted or nil,
       replayEntries = type(replaySerialization) == "table" and replaySerialization.entries or nil,
       replayBudgetExhausted = type(replaySerialization) == "table" and replaySerialization.budgetExhausted or nil
      }
     })
     liveState.processed += 1
    end)
    if not ok then
     liveState.serializationFailures += 1
     liveState.lastCaptureError = tostring(err)
    end
   end
   if os.clock() - started >= 0.002 then return liveState.queue.count > 0 end
  end
  return false
 end)
 return true
local function captureOutgoing(liveState, remote, method, packed, backend)
 if not remoteBackendActive(liveState, backend) then return false, nil end
 if remoteMethods[method] ~= true then return false, nil end
 if type(liveState.selfTest) == "table" then
  local label = tostring(packed[1])
  liveState.selfTest.counts[label] = (liveState.selfTest.counts[label] or 0) + 1
  liveState.selfTest.backends[backend] = (liveState.selfTest.backends[backend] or 0) + 1
  return false, nil
 end
 local className = remoteClassName(remote)
 if not outgoingClassAllowed(liveState, className, method) then return false, nil end
 local fromExecutor = false
 local callerCheck = nativeLookup("checkcaller")
 if type(callerCheck) == "function" then
  local callerOk, result = pcall(callerCheck)
  fromExecutor = callerOk and result == true
 end
 if not liveState.includeExecutor and fromExecutor then return false, nil end
 local blockingEnabled = liveState.profile ~= "stealth"
 local blockedMethods = blockingEnabled and liveState.blockedByInstance[remote] or nil
 local ignoredMethods = blockingEnabled and liveState.ignoredByInstance[remote] or nil
 if blockingEnabled and (blockedMethods == nil or ignoredMethods == nil)
  and (next(liveState.rules.blocked) ~= nil or next(liveState.rules.ignored) ~= nil)
 then
  local debugId = getInstanceDebugId(remote)
  if debugId then
   blockedMethods = blockedMethods or liveState.blockedByDebugId[debugId]
   ignoredMethods = ignoredMethods or liveState.ignoredByDebugId[debugId]
  end
 end
 local blocked = type(blockedMethods) == "table" and blockedMethods[method] == true
 if type(ignoredMethods) == "table" and ignoredMethods[method] == true then return blocked, nil end
 if liveState.queue.count >= liveState.queue.capacity then
  liveState.queue.dropped += 1
  return blocked, nil
 end
 local callingScript = nil
 if liveState.captureCallingScript then
  local getCallingScript = nativeLookup("getcallingscript")
  if type(getCallingScript) == "function" then
   local ok, result = pcall(getCallingScript)
   if ok then callingScript = result end
  end
 end
 local record = {
  at = os.clock(),
  remote = remote,
  method = method,
  className = className,
  direction = "outbound",
  backend = backend,
  fromExecutor = fromExecutor,
  blocked = blocked,
  packed = remoteLimits.boundedPacked(packed, 1),
  callingScript = callingScript,
  captureGeneration = liveState.captureGeneration,
  awaitReturn = liveState.captureReturns and (method == "InvokeServer" or method == "Invoke"),
  allowReplay = liveState.profile ~= "stealth"
 if not record.awaitReturn then enqueueRemoteCapture(liveState, record) end
 return blocked, record
local function completeRemoteCapture(liveState, record, startedAt, outcome)
 if type(record) ~= "table" or record.awaitReturn ~= true then return end
 record.durationSeconds = math.max(0, os.clock() - startedAt)
 if outcome[1] then
  record.returned = remoteLimits.boundedPacked(outcome, 2)
 else
  record.invocationError = truncate(outcome[2], 1000)
 end
 enqueueRemoteCapture(liveState, record)
local function invokeCapturedRemote(liveState, remote, method, packed, backend, original)
 local blocked, record = captureOutgoing(liveState, remote, method, packed, backend)
 if blocked then return nil end
 if type(record) ~= "table" or record.awaitReturn ~= true then
  return original(remote, table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n))
 end
 local startedAt = os.clock()
 local outcome = table.pack(pcall(original, remote, table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)))
 completeRemoteCapture(liveState, record, startedAt, outcome)
 if outcome[1] then return table.unpack(outcome, 2, outcome.n) end
 error(outcome[2], 0)
local function installRemoteMethodHooks()
 local hookState = runtime.remoteHooks.methods
 if type(hookState) == "table" and hookState.version == 3 and hookState.installed == true then
  return true, hookState.coverage or {}, hookState.errors or {}
 end
 local hookFunction = nativeLookup("hookfunction")
 if type(hookFunction) ~= "function" then return false, {}, {hookfunction = "unavailable"} end
 local wrap = nativeLookup("newcclosure") or function(fn) return fn end
 local specs = {
  {className = "RemoteEvent", method = "FireServer"},
  {className = "UnreliableRemoteEvent", method = "FireServer"},
  {className = "RemoteFunction", method = "InvokeServer"},
  {className = "BindableEvent", method = "Fire"},
  {className = "BindableFunction", method = "Invoke"}
 local coverage = {}
 local errors = {}
 local entries = {}
 local installed = 0
 for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do
  local objectOk, object = pcall(Instance.new, spec.className)
  if objectOk and object then
   local targetOk, target = pcall(function() return object[spec.method] end)
   if targetOk and type(target) == "function" then
    local original
    local replacement
    local fixedMethod = spec.method
    local hookOk, hookError = pcall(function()
     replacement = wrap(function(self, ...)
      local liveState = runtime.remote
      local dispatch = runtime.remoteDispatch
      if type(dispatch) == "function" and remoteBackendActive(liveState, "method") then
       return dispatch(liveState, self, fixedMethod, table.pack(...), "method", original)
      end
      return original(self, ...)
     end)
     original = hookFunction(target, replacement)
    end)
    if hookOk and type(original) == "function" then
     coverage[spec.className .. "." .. spec.method] = true
     entries[#entries + 1] = {key = spec.className .. "." .. spec.method, target = target, original = original, replacement = replacement}
     installed += 1
    else
     errors[spec.className .. "." .. spec.method] = tostring(hookError or "hookfunction returned no original")
    end
   else
    errors[spec.className .. "." .. spec.method] = "method unavailable"
   end
   pcall(object.Destroy, object)
  else
   errors[spec.className .. "." .. spec.method] = tostring(object)
  end
 end
 runtime.remoteHooks.methods = {
  version = 3,
  installed = installed > 0,
  hookFunction = hookFunction,
  entries = entries,
  coverage = coverage,
  errors = errors
 return installed > 0, coverage, errors
local function runRemoteBackendSelfTest(captureDirectCalls, testReturns)
 local selfTest = {counts = {}, backends = {}}
 spyState.selfTest = selfTest
 local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
 local cached = bindable.Fire
 local callOk, callError = pcall(function()
  bindable:Fire("colon", nil, 3)
  if captureDirectCalls then
   bindable.Fire(bindable, "dot", nil, 3)
   cached(bindable, "cached", nil, 3)
  end
 end)
 pcall(bindable.Destroy, bindable)
 local semanticsOk = true
 local semanticError = nil
 if testReturns then
  local bindableFunction = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
  bindableFunction.OnInvoke = function(first, second, third) return first, second, third end
  local returnOk, returned = pcall(function()
   return table.pack(bindableFunction:Invoke("returns", nil, 3))
  end)
  semanticsOk = returnOk
   and returned.n == 3
   and returned[1] == "returns"
   and returned[2] == nil
   and returned[3] == 3
  if not returnOk then semanticError = tostring(returned) end
  pcall(bindableFunction.Destroy, bindableFunction)
 end
 spyState.selfTest = nil
 local coverage = {
  colon = selfTest.counts.colon == 1,
  dot = captureDirectCalls and selfTest.counts.dot == 1 or false,
  cached = captureDirectCalls and selfTest.counts.cached == 1 or false,
  exactOnce = selfTest.counts.colon == 1
   and (not captureDirectCalls or (selfTest.counts.dot == 1 and selfTest.counts.cached == 1)),
  returns = testReturns and semanticsOk or false,
  errors = "not-runtime-probed"
 local result = {
  passed = callOk and coverage.exactOnce and semanticsOk,
  callError = callOk and nil or tostring(callError),
  semanticError = semanticError,
  counts = selfTest.counts,
  backends = selfTest.backends,
  coverage = coverage
 spyState.coverage = coverage
 spyState.selfTests = result
 spyState.backend = captureDirectCalls and coverage.exactOnce and "hybrid" or "namecall"
 return result
local function installRemoteHook()
 local hookState = runtime.remoteHooks.namecall
 if type(hookState) == "table" and hookState.version == 5 and hookState.installed == true then return true end
 local hookMeta = nativeLookup("hookmetamethod")
 local getMethod = nativeLookup("getnamecallmethod")
 if type(hookMeta) ~= "function" or type(getMethod) ~= "function" then
  spyState.hookError = "hookmetamethod/getnamecallmethod unavailable"
  return false
 end
 local wrap = nativeLookup("newcclosure") or function(fn) return fn end
 local oldNamecall
 local replacement
 local ok, err = pcall(function()
  -- FLOW_REMOTE_SPY_HOOK_BEGIN
  replacement = wrap(function(self, ...)
   local method = getMethod()
   local liveState = runtime.remote
   local dispatch = runtime.remoteDispatch
   if type(dispatch) == "function" and remoteMethods[method] and remoteBackendActive(liveState, "namecall") then
    return dispatch(liveState, self, method, table.pack(...), "namecall", oldNamecall)
   end
   return oldNamecall(self, ...)
  end)
  oldNamecall = hookMeta(game, "__namecall", replacement)
  -- FLOW_REMOTE_SPY_HOOK_END
 end)
 if not ok then
  spyState.hookError = tostring(err)
  return false
 end
 runtime.remoteHooks.namecall = {
  version = 5,
  installed = true,
  hookMeta = hookMeta,
  original = oldNamecall,
  replacement = replacement
 return true
local remoteLifecycle = {}
function remoteLifecycle.restoreMethods()
 local hookState = runtime.remoteHooks.methods
 if type(hookState) ~= "table" or hookState.installed ~= true then
  runtime.remoteHooks.methods = nil
  return {restored = 0, errors = {}}
 end
 local hookFunction = hookState.hookFunction
 local restored = 0
 local errors = {}
 local remaining = {}
 for index = #(hookState.entries or {}), 1, -1 do
  local entry = hookState.entries[index]
  local ok, err = pcall(hookFunction, entry.target, entry.original)
  if ok then
   restored += 1
  else
   errors[entry.key or tostring(index)] = tostring(err)
   table.insert(remaining, 1, entry)
  end
 end
 if #remaining == 0 then
  runtime.remoteHooks.methods = nil
 else
  hookState.entries = remaining
  hookState.errors = errors
  hookState.installed = true
 end
 return {restored = restored, errors = errors}
function remoteLifecycle.restoreNamecall()
 local hookState = runtime.remoteHooks.namecall
 if type(hookState) ~= "table" or hookState.installed ~= true then
  runtime.remoteHooks.namecall = nil
  return {restored = false}
 end
 local ok, err = pcall(hookState.hookMeta, game, "__namecall", hookState.original)
 if ok then
  runtime.remoteHooks.namecall = nil
  return {restored = true}
 end
 hookState.restoreError = tostring(err)
 return {restored = false, error = tostring(err)}
function remoteLifecycle.restoreHooks()
 local methodResult = remoteLifecycle.restoreMethods()
 local namecallResult = remoteLifecycle.restoreNamecall()
 return {
  namecallRestored = namecallResult.restored == true,
  namecallError = namecallResult.error,
  methodsRestored = methodResult.restored,
  methodErrors = methodResult.errors
local function disconnectInboundConnections(liveState)
 for connection in pairs(liveState.inboundConnections) do
  pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
  liveState.inboundConnections[connection] = nil
 end
 liveState.inboundByInstance = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
 liveState.ownedConnections = 0
function remoteLifecycle.stop(reason)
 spyState.enabled = false
 spyState.captureGeneration += 1
 spyState.leaseGeneration += 1
 captureQueueClear(spyState.queue)
 disconnectInboundConnections(spyState)
 runtime.remoteDispatch = nil
 runtimeState.resolveInstancePath = nil
 spyState.captureDirectCalls = false
 spyState.captureReturns = false
 spyState.blockedByInstance = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
 spyState.ignoredByInstance = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
 spyState.blockedByDebugId = {}
 spyState.ignoredByDebugId = {}
 spyState.rules = {blocked = {}, ignored = {}}
 spyState.identityByInstance = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
 spyState.expiresAt = nil
 spyState.stopReason = tostring(reason or "manual")
 local teardown = remoteLifecycle.restoreHooks()
 spyState.lastTeardown = teardown
 return teardown
local function connectInboundRemote(liveState, remote)
 if type(liveState) ~= "table" or liveState.enabled ~= true or liveState.profile ~= "full" or liveState.captureInbound ~= true then return false end
 if typeof(remote) ~= "Instance" or liveState.inboundByInstance[remote] then return false end
 local className = remoteClassName(remote)
 if className ~= "RemoteEvent" and className ~= "UnreliableRemoteEvent" then return false end
 local ok, connection = pcall(function()
  return remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
   if liveState.enabled ~= true or liveState.captureInbound ~= true then return end
   if type(liveState.methods) == "table" and liveState.methods.OnClientEvent ~= true then return end
   enqueueRemoteCapture(liveState, {
    at = os.clock(),
    remote = remote,
    method = "OnClientEvent",
    className = className,
    direction = "inbound",
    backend = "connection",
    fromExecutor = false,
    blocked = false,
    packed = remoteLimits.boundedPacked(table.pack(...), 1),
    captureGeneration = liveState.captureGeneration
   })
  end)
 end)
 if not ok or not connection then
  liveState.inboundErrors[className .. ":" .. safePath(remote)] = tostring(connection)
  return false
 end
 liveState.inboundByInstance[remote] = connection
 liveState.inboundConnections[connection] = true
 liveState.inboundConnected += 1
 liveState.ownedConnections += 1
 return true
local function startInboundCapture(liveState)
 disconnectInboundConnections(liveState)
 if liveState.profile ~= "full" or liveState.captureInbound ~= true then return end
 liveState.inboundScanned = 0
 liveState.inboundConnected = 0
 liveState.inboundErrors = {}
 local captureGeneration = liveState.captureGeneration
 local added = game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
  if liveState.enabled == true and liveState.captureInbound == true then connectInboundRemote(liveState, instance) end
 end)
 local removing = game.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
  local connection = liveState.inboundByInstance[instance]
  if connection then
   pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
   liveState.inboundConnections[connection] = nil
   liveState.inboundByInstance[instance] = nil
   liveState.ownedConnections = math.max(0, liveState.ownedConnections - 1)
  end
 end)
 liveState.inboundConnections[added] = true
 liveState.inboundConnections[removing] = true
 liveState.ownedConnections = 2
 local ok, roots = pcall(game.GetChildren, game)
 if not ok or type(roots) ~= "table" then
  liveState.inboundErrors.discovery = tostring(roots)
  return
 end
 local queue = {}
 for _, instance in ipairs(roots) do queue[#queue + 1] = instance end
 local cursor = 1
 local scanTruncated = false
 local started = os.clock()
 while cursor <= #queue and liveState.inboundScanned < MAX_NATIVE_LIST_SCAN do
  if liveState.captureGeneration ~= captureGeneration or liveState.enabled ~= true then return end
  local instance = queue[cursor]
  cursor += 1
  liveState.inboundScanned += 1
  connectInboundRemote(liveState, instance)
  local childrenOk, children = pcall(instance.GetChildren, instance)
  if childrenOk and type(children) == "table" then
   for _, child in ipairs(children) do
    if #queue >= MAX_NATIVE_LIST_SCAN then
     scanTruncated = true
     break
    end
    queue[#queue + 1] = child
   end
  end
  if os.clock() - started >= 0.002 then
   task.wait()
   started = os.clock()
  end
 end
 if scanTruncated or cursor <= #queue then
  liveState.inboundErrors.discovery = "breadth-first scan truncated at " .. tostring(MAX_NATIVE_LIST_SCAN) .. " instances"
 end
local function pruneRemoteRules(liveState)
 for _, kind in ipairs({"blocked", "ignored"}) do
  local records = liveState.rules[kind]
  for id, record in pairs(records) do
   local target = record.target
   local live = typeof(target) == "Instance"
   if live and target ~= game then
    local ok, parent = pcall(function() return target.Parent end)
    live = ok and parent ~= nil
   end
   if not live then
    local methods = target and (kind == "blocked" and liveState.blockedByInstance[target] or liveState.ignoredByInstance[target]) or nil
    if type(methods) == "table" then
     methods[record.method] = nil
     if next(methods) == nil then
      if kind == "blocked" then liveState.blockedByInstance[target] = nil else liveState.ignoredByInstance[target] = nil end
     end
    end
    local debugIndex = kind == "blocked" and liveState.blockedByDebugId or liveState.ignoredByDebugId
    local debugMethods = record.debugId and debugIndex[record.debugId] or nil
    if type(debugMethods) == "table" then
     debugMethods[record.method] = nil
     if next(debugMethods) == nil then debugIndex[record.debugId] = nil end
    end
    records[id] = nil
    liveState.invalidatedRules += 1
   end
  end
 end
local function displayedRemoteRules(liveState, kind)
 pruneRemoteRules(liveState)
 local result = {}
 for _, record in pairs(liveState.rules[kind]) do
  result[#result + 1] = {key = record.key, method = record.method, className = record.className, path = record.path, handle = record.target and getHandle(record.target) or record.handle}
 end
 table.sort(result, function(first, second) return first.key < second.key end)
 return result
local nativeDecompile = nativeLookup("decompile")
local nativeBytecode = nativeLookup("getscriptbytecode")
local nativeGetEnv = nativeLookup("getsenv")
local nativeGetGc = nativeLookup("getgc")
local nativeReadFile = nativeLookup("readfile")
local nativeLoadString = nativeLookup("loadstring") or loadstring

 request = type(requestFn) == "function",
 decompile = type(nativeDecompile) == "function",
 bytecode = type(nativeBytecode) == "function",
 getsenv = type(nativeGetEnv) == "function",
 getgc = type(nativeGetGc) == "function",
 readfile = type(nativeReadFile) == "function",
 loadstring = type(nativeLoadString) == "function",
 remoteSpy = (type(nativeLookup("hookmetamethod")) == "function"
   and type(nativeLookup("getnamecallmethod")) == "function")
  or type(nativeLookup("hookfunction")) == "function",
 getconnections = type(nativeGetConnections) == "function",
 getinstances = type(nativeGetInstances) == "function",
 getnilinstances = type(nativeGetNilInstances) == "function",
 gethiddenproperty = type(nativeGetHiddenProperty) == "function",
 getrunningscripts = type(nativeGetRunningScripts) == "function",
 getloadedmodules = type(nativeGetLoadedModules) == "function",
 getcallbackvalue = type(nativeGetCallbackValue) == "function",
 getscriptclosure = type(nativeGetScriptClosure) == "function",
 getconstants = type(nativeGetConstants) == "function",
 getprotos = type(nativeGetProtos) == "function",
 getupvalues = type(nativeGetUpvalues) == "function",
 debugUpvalues = type((rawget(env, "debug") or debug) and ((rawget(env, "debug") or debug).getupvalues or (rawget(env, "debug") or debug).getupvalue)) == "function",
 firesignal = type(nativeFireSignal) == "function",
 fireproximityprompt = type(nativeFirePrompt) == "function",
 fireclickdetector = type(nativeFireClick) == "function",
 firetouchinterest = type(nativeFireTouch) == "function"
local function requireCapability(name, value)
 if type(value) ~= "function" then error("UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY:" .. name) end
 return value

 handlers["get-game-info"] = function()
  if cachedPlaceId ~= game.PlaceId then
   local ok, info = pcall(function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId) end)
   if ok and type(info) == "table" and type(info.Name) == "string" then
    cachedPlaceId, cachedPlaceName = game.PlaceId, info.Name
   end
  end

  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

   placeId = game.PlaceId,
   gameId = game.GameId,

   loaded = game:IsLoaded(),

   userId = lp and lp.UserId or 0,
   character = char and instanceSummary(char) or nil,
   position = hrp and safeValue(hrp.Position) or nil,
   executor = status.executorName

handlers["search-instances"] = function(payload)
 local root = resolveInstance(payload)
 local nameNeedle = string.lower(decodeByteEscapes(tostring(payload.query or payload.nameContains or "")))
 local className = tostring(payload.className or "")
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 500, 50)
 local results = {}
 local scanned, scanTruncated = walk(root, clamp(payload.maxDepth, 0, 30, 12), function(instance)
  local matchesName = nameNeedle == "" or string.find(string.lower(instance.Name), nameNeedle, 1, true) ~= nil
  local matchesClass = className == "" or instance.ClassName == className
  if not matchesClass and className ~= "" then
   local classOk, isClass = pcall(instance.IsA, instance, className)
   matchesClass = classOk and isClass
  end
  if matchesName and matchesClass then table.insert(results, instanceSummary(instance)) end
  return #results < limit
 end)
 return {results = results, scanned = scanned, truncated = #results >= limit or scanned >= MAX_SEARCH_SCAN or scanTruncated}

-- FLOW_NATIVE_LIST_BEGIN
local function nativeListValues(capability, provider)
 local native = requireCapability(capability, provider)
 local ok, values = pcall(native)
 if not ok then error(capability .. " failed: " .. tostring(values)) end
 if type(values) ~= "table" then error(capability .. " returned " .. typeof(values) .. " instead of a table") end
 return values
local function nativeListTotal(values)
 local total = 0
 local budget = newTraversalRuntime()
 for _ in next, values do
  total += 1
  cooperativeCheckpoint(budget, 1)
 end
 return total
local function listNativeInstances(capability, provider, payload, unparentedOnly, fieldName)
 local values = nativeListValues(capability, provider)
 local total = nativeListTotal(values)
 local query = string.lower(tostring(payload.query or ""))
 local className = tostring(payload.className or "")
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 1000, 200)
 local filtered = query ~= "" or className ~= ""
 local scanLimit = filtered and math.min(total, MAX_NATIVE_LIST_SCAN) or math.min(total, limit)
 local results = {}
 local scanned = 0
 local matched = 0
 local runtimeBudget = newTraversalRuntime()
 for _, instance in pairs(values) do
  if scanned >= scanLimit then break end
  scanned += 1
  cooperativeCheckpoint(runtimeBudget, 1)
  if typeof(instance) == "Instance" then
   local matchesName = query == "" or string.find(string.lower(tostring(instance.Name)), query, 1, true) ~= nil
   local matchesClass = className == "" or remoteClassName(instance) == className
   if not matchesClass and className ~= "" then
    local classOk, isClass = pcall(instance.IsA, instance, className)
    matchesClass = classOk and isClass
   end
   if matchesName and matchesClass then
    matched += 1
    if #results < limit then
     results[#results + 1] = unparentedOnly and unparentedInstanceSummary(instance) or instanceSummary(instance)
    end
    if filtered and #results >= limit then break end
   end
  end
 end
 if not filtered then matched = total end
 local response = {
  supported = true,
  provider = capability,
  total = total,
  scanned = scanned,
  scanLimit = scanLimit,
  complete = scanned >= total,
  matched = matched,
  returned = #results,
  truncated = scanned < total or matched > #results
 response[fieldName or "instances"] = results
 return response
-- FLOW_NATIVE_LIST_END

handlers["get-hidden-property"] = function(payload)
 local instance = resolveInstance(payload)
 local property = tostring(payload.property or "")
 if property == "" then error("property is required") end
 local getter = requireCapability("gethiddenproperty", nativeGetHiddenProperty)
 local result = table.pack(pcall(getter, instance, property))
 if not result[1] then error("gethiddenproperty failed for " .. property .. ": " .. tostring(result[2])) end
 return {
  supported = true,
  instance = instanceSummary(instance),
  property = property,
  value = safeValue(result[2]),
  hidden = result.n >= 3 and result[3] == true or false,
  hiddenKnown = result.n >= 3
handlers["watch-instance-property"] = function(payload)
 local instance = resolveInstance(payload)
 local property = tostring(payload.property or "")
 if property == "" then error("property is required") end
 if countEntries(watchers) >= MAX_PROPERTY_WATCHES then
  error("property watch limit reached (" .. tostring(MAX_PROPERTY_WATCHES) .. ")")
 end
 nextWatchId += 1
 local watchId = "w" .. tostring(nextWatchId)
 local signal = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property)
 local watcher = {}
 watchers[watchId] = watcher
 watcher.property = signal:Connect(function()
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
  ringPush(watchEvents, {
   watchId = watchId,
   at = os.clock(),
   instance = instanceSummary(instance),
   property = property,
   ok = ok,
   value = safeValue(value)
  })
 end)
 watcher.destroying = instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
  local active = watchers[watchId]
  if active then
   watchers[watchId] = nil
   disconnectWatcher(active)
  end
 end)
 return {watchId = watchId, instance = instanceSummary(instance), property = property}
handlers["stop-watch"] = function(payload)
 local watchId = tostring(payload.watchId or "")
 local watcher = watchers[watchId]
 if watcher then disconnectWatcher(watcher) end
 watchers[watchId] = nil
 return {stopped = watcher ~= nil, watchId = watchId}
handlers["get-watch-events"] = function(payload)
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 300, 100)
 local watchId = tostring(payload.watchId or "")
 local newest = {}
 for i = watchEvents.count, 1, -1 do
  local event = ringGet(watchEvents, i)
  if watchId == "" or event.watchId == watchId then
   table.insert(newest, event)
   if #newest >= limit then break end
  end
 end
 local result = {}
 for i = #newest, 1, -1 do table.insert(result, newest[i]) end
 return result

handlers["get-signal-connections"] = function(payload)
 local instance = resolveInstance(payload)
 local signalName = tostring(payload.signal or "")
 if signalName == "" then error("signal is required") end
 local signalOk, signal = pcall(function() return instance[signalName] end)
 if not signalOk or typeof(signal) ~= "RBXScriptSignal" then error("target property is not an RBXScriptSignal: " .. signalName) end
 local getConnections = requireCapability("getconnections", nativeGetConnections)
 local ok, connections = pcall(getConnections, signal)
 if not ok then error("getconnections failed for " .. signalName .. ": " .. tostring(connections)) end
 if type(connections) ~= "table" then error("getconnections returned " .. typeof(connections) .. " instead of a table") end
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 500, 100)
 local result = {}
 for index = 1, math.min(#connections, limit) do
  local connection = connections[index]
  local callback = safeConnectionProperty(connection, "Function")
  result[index] = {
   index = index,
   enabled = safeConnectionProperty(connection, "Enabled"),
   connected = safeConnectionProperty(connection, "Connected"),
   luaConnection = safeConnectionProperty(connection, "LuaConnection"),
   hasFunction = type(callback) == "function",
   canFire = type(safeConnectionProperty(connection, "Fire")) == "function",
   canEnable = type(safeConnectionProperty(connection, "Enable")) == "function",
   canDisable = type(safeConnectionProperty(connection, "Disable")) == "function"
 end
 return {
  supported = true,
  instance = instanceSummary(instance),
  signal = signalName,
  total = #connections,
  returned = #result,
  truncated = #connections > #result,
  connections = result
local function functionSummary(value)
 if type(value) ~= "function" then return {type = typeof(value)} end
 local summary = {type = "function"}
 local info = nativeDebug and nativeDebug.info
 if type(info) == "function" then
  local sourceOk, source = pcall(info, value, "s")
  local lineOk, line = pcall(info, value, "l")
  local nameOk, name = pcall(info, value, "n")
  local arityOk, arity, variadic = pcall(info, value, "a")
  if sourceOk then summary.source = truncate(source, 500) end
  if lineOk then summary.line = line end
  if nameOk and name ~= "" then summary.name = truncate(name, 200) end
  if arityOk then summary.arity = arity; summary.variadic = variadic == true end
 end
 return summary
