local function boundedDebugValues(values, limit, summarizeFunctions)
 local results = {}
 local total = type(values) == "table" and nativeListTotal(values) or 0
 if type(values) == "table" then
  local added = 0
  for key, value in pairs(values) do
   if added >= limit then break end
   added += 1
   results[#results + 1] = {
    key = safeTableKey(key),
    value = summarizeFunctions and functionSummary(value) or safeValue(value, 0, nil, 1000, {remaining = 100})
   }
  end
 end
 return results, total, total > #results
handlers["get-script-debug-info"] = function(payload)
 local scriptObject = resolveInstance(payload)
 if not isScript(scriptObject) then error("target is not a Roblox script") end
 local getClosure = requireCapability("getscriptclosure", nativeGetScriptClosure)
 local closureOk, closure = pcall(getClosure, scriptObject)
 if not closureOk then error("getscriptclosure failed: " .. tostring(closure)) end
 if type(closure) ~= "function" then error("getscriptclosure returned " .. typeof(closure) .. " instead of a function") end
 local errors = {}
 local constants, constantsTotal, constantsTruncated = {}, 0, false
 if type(nativeGetConstants) == "function" then
  local ok, values = pcall(nativeGetConstants, closure)
  if ok and type(values) == "table" then
   constants, constantsTotal, constantsTruncated = boundedDebugValues(values, clamp(payload.maxConstants, 0, 1000, 200), false)
  else
   errors.constants = tostring(values)
  end
 end
 local prototypes, prototypesTotal, prototypesTruncated = {}, 0, false
 if type(nativeGetProtos) == "function" then
  local ok, values = pcall(nativeGetProtos, closure)
  if ok and type(values) == "table" then
   prototypes, prototypesTotal, prototypesTruncated = boundedDebugValues(values, clamp(payload.maxPrototypes, 0, 200, 50), true)
  else
   errors.prototypes = tostring(values)
  end
 end
 local upvalues, upvaluesTotal, upvaluesTruncated = {}, 0, false
 if type(nativeGetUpvalues) == "function" then
  local ok, values = pcall(nativeGetUpvalues, closure)
  if ok and type(values) == "table" then
   upvalues, upvaluesTotal, upvaluesTruncated = boundedDebugValues(values, clamp(payload.maxUpvalues, 0, 500, 100), false)
  else
   errors.upvalues = tostring(values)
  end
 end
 return {
  supported = true,
  script = instanceSummary(scriptObject),
  closure = functionSummary(closure),
  capabilities = {
   getconstants = type(nativeGetConstants) == "function",
   getprotos = type(nativeGetProtos) == "function",
   getupvalues = type(nativeGetUpvalues) == "function"
  },
  constants = constants,
  constantsTotal = constantsTotal,
  constantsTruncated = constantsTruncated,
  prototypes = prototypes,
  prototypesTotal = prototypesTotal,
  prototypesTruncated = prototypesTruncated,
  upvalues = upvalues,
  upvaluesTotal = upvaluesTotal,
  upvaluesTruncated = upvaluesTruncated,
  errors = errors
handlers["list-scripts"] = function(payload)
 local root = resolveInstance(payload)
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 1000, 200)
 local results = {}
 local scanned, scanTruncated = walk(root, clamp(payload.maxDepth, 0, 40, 20), function(instance)
  if isScript(instance) then table.insert(results, instanceSummary(instance)) end
  return #results < limit
 end)
 return {
  scripts = results,
  scanned = scanned,
  truncated = #results >= limit or scanned >= MAX_SEARCH_SCAN or scanTruncated
handlers["search-scripts"] = function(payload)
 local root = resolveInstance(payload)
 local query = string.lower(tostring(payload.query or ""))
 local includeSource = payload.includeSource == true
 local sourceScanLimit = includeSource and clamp(payload.sourceScanLimit, 0, remoteLimits.maxSourceScan, remoteLimits.defaultSourceScan) or 0
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 100, 20)
 local results = {}
 local decompiled = 0
 local slowestDecompileSeconds = 0
 local stoppedForSlowDecompile = false
 local scanned, scanTruncated = walk(root, clamp(payload.maxDepth, 0, 40, 20), function(instance)
  if not isScript(instance) then return true end
  local path = safePath(instance)
  local source = nil
  local matched = query == "" or string.find(string.lower(path), query, 1, true) ~= nil
  if includeSource and type(nativeDecompile) == "function" and decompiled < sourceScanLimit then
   decompiled += 1
   local decompileStartedAt = os.clock()
   local ok, value = pcall(nativeDecompile, instance)
   local decompileElapsed = math.max(0, os.clock() - decompileStartedAt)
   slowestDecompileSeconds = math.max(slowestDecompileSeconds, decompileElapsed)
   if decompileElapsed >= remoteLimits.maxDecompileCallSeconds then stoppedForSlowDecompile = true end
   if ok and type(value) == "string" then
    source = value
    if not matched then matched = string.find(string.lower(value), query, 1, true) ~= nil end
   end
  end
  if matched then
   local item = instanceSummary(instance)
   if includeSource and source then item.source = truncate(source, MAX_SERIALIZE_STRING) end
   table.insert(results, item)
  end
  return #results < limit and not stoppedForSlowDecompile
 end)
 return {
  results = results,
  scanned = scanned,
  decompiled = decompiled,
  sourceScanLimit = sourceScanLimit,
  slowestDecompileSeconds = slowestDecompileSeconds,
  stoppedForSlowDecompile = stoppedForSlowDecompile,
  truncated = #results >= limit or scanned >= MAX_SEARCH_SCAN or scanTruncated or stoppedForSlowDecompile
handlers["get-script-source"] = function(payload)
 local scriptObject = resolveInstance(payload)
 if not isScript(scriptObject) then error("target is not a Roblox script") end
 local decompileFn = requireCapability("decompile", nativeDecompile)
 local now = os.clock()
 local cache = runtime.decompileCache
 local cacheHit = type(cache) == "table"
  and cache.generation == runtimeState.generation
  and cache.target == scriptObject
  and now - (tonumber(cache.at) or 0) <= remoteLimits.scriptCacheSeconds
 local source
 local nativeSeconds = 0
 if cacheHit then
  source = cache.value
 else
  local nativeStartedAt = os.clock()
  local ok, value = pcall(decompileFn, scriptObject)
  nativeSeconds = math.max(0, os.clock() - nativeStartedAt)
  if not ok then error("native decompile failed for " .. safePath(scriptObject) .. ": " .. tostring(value)) end
  source = tostring(value or "")
  if #source <= remoteLimits.scriptCacheBytes then
   runtime.decompileCache = {generation = runtimeState.generation, target = scriptObject, value = source, at = os.clock()}
  else
   runtime.decompileCache = nil
  end
 end
 source = tostring(source or "")
 local maxChars = clamp(payload.maxChars, 100, remoteLimits.maxScriptPageChars, 32000)
 local rawPage, offsetBytes = utf8SafeSlice(source, payload.offsetBytes, maxChars)
 -- Escaping invalid UTF-8 lengthens text, so the page is bounded here and paging advances by
 -- the raw source bytes it covers; otherwise the serializer would cut it and pages would skip.
 local page, returnedBytes = sanitizeUtf8(rawPage, maxChars)
 local nextOffsetBytes = offsetBytes + returnedBytes
 local complete = nextOffsetBytes >= #source
 if complete then nextOffsetBytes = nil end
 return {
  provider = "executor-native",
  script = instanceSummary(scriptObject),
  source = page,
  invalidUtf8Escaped = page ~= string.sub(rawPage, 1, returnedBytes),
  totalChars = #source,
  totalBytes = #source,
  offsetBytes = offsetBytes,
  returnedBytes = returnedBytes,
  nextOffsetBytes = nextOffsetBytes,
  complete = complete,
  truncated = not complete,
  cacheHit = cacheHit,
  nativeSeconds = nativeSeconds
handlers["get-script-bytecode"] = function(payload)
 local scriptObject = resolveInstance(payload)
 if not isScript(scriptObject) then error("target is not a Roblox script") end
 local bytecodeFn = requireCapability("getscriptbytecode", nativeBytecode)
 local now = os.clock()
 local cache = runtime.bytecodeCache
 local cacheHit = type(cache) == "table"
  and cache.generation == runtimeState.generation
  and cache.target == scriptObject
  and now - (tonumber(cache.at) or 0) <= remoteLimits.scriptCacheSeconds
 local bytecode
 local nativeSeconds = 0
 if cacheHit then
  bytecode = cache.value
 else
  local nativeStartedAt = os.clock()
  local ok, value = pcall(bytecodeFn, scriptObject)
  nativeSeconds = math.max(0, os.clock() - nativeStartedAt)
  if not ok then error("bytecode failed for " .. safePath(scriptObject) .. ": " .. tostring(value)) end
  bytecode = tostring(value or "")
  if #bytecode <= remoteLimits.scriptCacheBytes then
   runtime.bytecodeCache = {generation = runtimeState.generation, target = scriptObject, value = bytecode, at = os.clock()}
  else
   runtime.bytecodeCache = nil
  end
 end
 bytecode = tostring(bytecode or "")
 local maxChars = clamp(payload.maxChars, 100, remoteLimits.maxScriptPageChars, 32000)
 local offsetBytes = clamp(payload.offsetBytes, 0, #bytecode, 0)
 local encoded = toHex(string.sub(bytecode, offsetBytes + 1), maxChars)
 local returnedBytes = #encoded / 2
 local nextOffsetBytes = offsetBytes + returnedBytes
 local complete = nextOffsetBytes >= #bytecode
 if complete then nextOffsetBytes = nil end
 return {
  script = instanceSummary(scriptObject),
  bytecode = encoded,
  encoding = "hex",
  totalBytes = #bytecode,
  totalChars = #bytecode * 2,
  returnedChars = #encoded,
  offsetBytes = offsetBytes,
  returnedBytes = returnedBytes,
  nextOffsetBytes = nextOffsetBytes,
  complete = complete,
  truncated = not complete,
  cacheHit = cacheHit,
  nativeSeconds = nativeSeconds
handlers["get-script-environment"] = function(payload)
 local scriptObject = resolveInstance(payload)
 if not isEnvironmentScript(scriptObject) then error("target does not expose a client script environment") end
 local getEnv = requireCapability("getsenv", nativeGetEnv)
 local ok, scriptEnv = pcall(getEnv, scriptObject)
 if not ok then error("getsenv failed: " .. tostring(scriptEnv)) end
 if type(scriptEnv) ~= "table" then
  return {
   script = instanceSummary(scriptObject),
   available = false,
   reason = scriptEnv == nil and "script has no running environment"
    or "executor returned " .. typeof(scriptEnv) .. " instead of a table"
 end
 return {script = instanceSummary(scriptObject), available = true, environment = safeValue(scriptEnv)}
handlers["get-function-upvalues"] = function(payload)
 local scriptObject = resolveInstance(payload)
 if not isEnvironmentScript(scriptObject) then error("target does not expose a client script environment") end
 local functionName = tostring(payload.functionName or "")
 local getEnv = requireCapability("getsenv", nativeGetEnv)
 local envOk, scriptEnv = pcall(getEnv, scriptObject)
 if not envOk or type(scriptEnv) ~= "table" then error("getsenv failed: " .. tostring(scriptEnv)) end
 local target = scriptEnv[functionName]
 if type(target) ~= "function" then error("function not found in script environment: " .. functionName) end
 local debugLib = rawget(env, "debug") or debug
 local bulkGetter = debugLib and debugLib.getupvalues
 local singleGetter = debugLib and debugLib.getupvalue
 local upvalues = {}
 if type(bulkGetter) == "function" then
  local ok, values = pcall(bulkGetter, target)
  if not ok then error("upvalue inspection failed: " .. tostring(values)) end
  upvalues = values
 elseif type(singleGetter) == "function" then
  for index = 1, 100 do
   local values = table.pack(pcall(singleGetter, target, index))
   if not values[1] or values.n < 2 or values[2] == nil then break end
   if values.n >= 3 and type(values[2]) == "string" then
    upvalues[values[2]] = values[3]
   else
    upvalues[index] = values[2]
   end
  end
 else
  error("UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY:debug.getupvalues")
 end
 return {script = instanceSummary(scriptObject), functionName = functionName, upvalues = safeValue(upvalues)}
handlers["get-gc-summary"] = function(payload)
 local getGc = requireCapability("getgc", nativeGetGc)
 local objects = getGc(payload.includeTables == true)
 local limit = clamp(payload.scanLimit, 1, 100000, 50000)
 local counts = {}
 local samples = {}
 local sampleBudget = {remaining = 600, bytes = 32768}
 local sampleLimit = clamp(payload.sampleLimit, 0, 100, 20)
 local scanned = 0
 local runtime = newTraversalRuntime()
 for key, value in next, objects do
  scanned += 1
  if scanned > limit then break end
  cooperativeCheckpoint(runtime, 1)
  local kind = typeof(value)
  counts[kind] = (counts[kind] or 0) + 1
  if #samples < sampleLimit then table.insert(samples, {key = tostring(key), type = kind, value = safeValue(value, 0, nil, 512, sampleBudget, 10, 2)}) end
 end
 return {counts = counts, samples = samples, scanned = math.min(scanned, limit), truncated = scanned > limit}
local function runSource(source, chunkName)
 local loader = requireCapability("loadstring", nativeLoadString)
 local compiled, compileError = loader(tostring(source or ""), tostring(chunkName or "=FlowExecutorMCP"))
 if type(compiled) ~= "function" then error("compile failed: " .. tostring(compileError)) end
 local packed = table.pack(xpcall(compiled, function(err)
  local debugLib = rawget(env, "debug") or debug
  return debugLib and debugLib.traceback and debugLib.traceback(tostring(err), 2) or tostring(err)
 end))
 if not packed[1] then error(packed[2]) end
 local results = {}
 local budget = {remaining = MAX_SERIALIZE_TOTAL_ENTRIES, bytes = 262144}
 for i = 2, math.min(packed.n, 31) do results[i - 1] = safeValue(packed[i], 0, nil, nil, budget) end
 return {results = results, omitted = math.max(0, packed.n - 31)}
-- FLOW_RUNS_BEGIN
-- Scoped in a do block so it adds no locals: the main chunk is near Luau's local-register limit.
-- Tracked runs: every execute gets a run whose threads, RUN.connect connections, Instance.new
-- instances and RUN.onStop callbacks are torn down by stop-run, or by the next execute with the
-- same runKey (live reload). The registry lives in its own env key so it survives reinjection.
local RUNS_KEY = "__fx_runs_" .. string.sub(FLOW_TOKEN, 1, 16)
local runRegistry = rawget(env, RUNS_KEY)
if type(runRegistry) ~= "table" or type(runRegistry.byKey) ~= "table" then
 runRegistry = {byKey = {}, recent = {}, sequence = 0}
 rawset(env, RUNS_KEY, runRegistry)
local MAX_RUN_KEY_LENGTH = 64
local MAX_RECENT_RUNS = 16
local MAX_RUN_ERROR_CHARS = 2000
local realTask = task
local realInstance = Instance
local function runDispose(item)
 local kind = typeof(item)
 if kind == "RBXScriptConnection" then
  pcall(item.Disconnect, item)
 elseif kind == "Instance" then
  pcall(item.Destroy, item)
 elseif kind == "thread" then
  if item ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(realTask.cancel, item) end
 elseif kind == "function" then
  pcall(item)
 elseif kind == "table" then
  local method = rawget(item, "Disconnect") or rawget(item, "Destroy") or rawget(item, "disconnect") or rawget(item, "destroy")
  if type(method) == "function" then pcall(method, item) end
 end
local function runCounts(run)
 local threads, connections, instances = 0, 0, 0
 for thread in next, run.threads do
  if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then threads += 1 end
 end
 for _, connection in ipairs(run.connections) do
  local ok, connected = pcall(function() return connection.Connected end)
  if not ok or connected ~= false then connections += 1 end
 end
 for instance in next, run.instances do
  local ok, parent = pcall(function() return instance.Parent end)
  if ok and parent ~= nil then instances += 1 end
 end
 return threads, connections, instances
local function runHasLiveResources(run)
 if run.bodyRunning or #run.cleanups > 0 or #run.tracked > 0 then return true end
 local threads, connections, instances = runCounts(run)
 return threads + connections + instances > 0
local function runSummary(run)
 local threads, connections, instances = runCounts(run)
 return {
  runKey = run.key,
  status = run.status,
  chunkName = run.chunkName,
  background = run.background,
  startedAt = run.startedAt,
  ageSeconds = math.floor((os.clock() - run.startedClock) * 10) / 10,
  liveThreads = threads,
  connections = connections,
  instances = instances,
  cleanups = #run.cleanups,
  tracked = #run.tracked,
  stopReason = run.stopReason,
  lastError = run.lastError
local function retireRun(run, status, reason)
 if runRegistry.byKey[run.key] == run then runRegistry.byKey[run.key] = nil end
 run.status = status
 run.stopReason = reason
 table.insert(runRegistry.recent, 1, runSummary(run))
 while #runRegistry.recent > MAX_RECENT_RUNS do table.remove(runRegistry.recent) end
local function stopRun(run, reason)
 if not run.alive then return false end
 run.alive = false
 run.api.alive = false
 for index = #run.cleanups, 1, -1 do pcall(run.cleanups[index]) end
 for index = #run.tracked, 1, -1 do runDispose(run.tracked[index]) end
 for _, connection in ipairs(run.connections) do runDispose(connection) end
 for thread in next, run.threads do runDispose(thread) end
 for instance in next, run.instances do runDispose(instance) end
 table.clear(run.cleanups)
 table.clear(run.tracked)
 table.clear(run.connections)
 table.clear(run.threads)
 table.clear(run.instances)
 run.bodyRunning = false
 retireRun(run, "stopped", reason)
 return true
-- A run's threads end at their next wait once the run stops; the foreground body errors instead,
-- so the execute call reports it rather than hanging.
local function guardRunAlive(run)
 if run.alive then return end
 if coroutine.running() == run.foregroundThread then error("run stopped", 0) end
 while true do coroutine.yield() end
local function pruneRunConnections(run)
 if #run.connections < 256 then return end
 local live = {}
 for _, connection in ipairs(run.connections) do
  local ok, connected = pcall(function() return connection.Connected end)
  if not ok or connected ~= false then table.insert(live, connection) end
 end
 run.connections = live
-- Instance keys stay strong: Roblox may collect an Instance's Lua wrapper while the instance
-- itself lives on, so a weak table would forget parts and GUIs the run still owns.
local function pruneRunInstances(run)
 local count = 0
 for instance in next, run.instances do
  local ok, parent = pcall(function() return instance.Parent end)
  if ok and parent ~= nil then count += 1 else run.instances[instance] = nil end
 end
 run.instanceCount = count
local function makeRunEnvironment(run, baseEnv)
 local function trackThread(thread)
  if type(thread) == "thread" and run.alive then run.threads[thread] = true end
  return thread
 end
 local runTask = setmetatable({
  spawn = function(callback, ...)
   if not run.alive then return nil end
   return trackThread(realTask.spawn(callback, ...))
  end,
  defer = function(callback, ...)
   if not run.alive then return nil end
   return trackThread(realTask.defer(callback, ...))
  end,
  delay = function(seconds, callback, ...)
   if not run.alive then return nil end
   return trackThread(realTask.delay(seconds, callback, ...))
  end,
  wait = function(...)
   guardRunAlive(run)
   local packed = table.pack(realTask.wait(...))
   guardRunAlive(run)
   return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
  end
 }, {__index = realTask})
 local baseWait = baseEnv.wait or wait
 local api = {key = run.key, alive = true}
 function api.track(item)
  if item ~= nil and run.alive then table.insert(run.tracked, item) end
  return item
 end
 function api.connect(signal, callback)
  local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
  if run.alive then
   table.insert(run.connections, connection)
   pruneRunConnections(run)
  else
   connection:Disconnect()
  end
  return connection
 end
 function api.onStop(callback)
  assert(type(callback) == "function", "RUN.onStop expects a function")
  if run.alive then table.insert(run.cleanups, callback) else pcall(callback) end
 end
 function api.stop()
  stopRun(run, "self")
 end
 run.api = api
 local overrides = {
  RUN = api,
  task = runTask,
  wait = function(...)
   guardRunAlive(run)
   local packed = table.pack(baseWait(...))
   guardRunAlive(run)
   return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
  end,
  spawn = function(callback) runTask.defer(callback) end,
  delay = function(seconds, callback) runTask.delay(seconds or 0, callback) end,
  Instance = setmetatable({
   new = function(...)
    local instance = realInstance.new(...)
    if run.alive then
     run.instances[instance] = true
     run.instanceCount += 1
     if run.instanceCount >= 1024 then pruneRunInstances(run) end
    end
    return instance
   end
  }, {__index = realInstance})
 return setmetatable(overrides, {
  __index = baseEnv,
  __newindex = function(_, key, value) baseEnv[key] = value end
local function normalizeRunKey(value)
 if value == nil then return nil end
 local key = tostring(value)
 if key == "" then return nil end
 if #key > MAX_RUN_KEY_LENGTH then error("INVALID_RUN_KEY:runKey is longer than " .. MAX_RUN_KEY_LENGTH .. " characters") end
 return key
local function packRunResults(packed)
 local results = {}
 local budget = {remaining = MAX_SERIALIZE_TOTAL_ENTRIES, bytes = 262144}
 for i = 2, math.min(packed.n, 31) do results[i - 1] = safeValue(packed[i], 0, nil, nil, budget) end
 return results, math.max(0, packed.n - 31)
local function runTraceback(err)
 local debugLib = rawget(env, "debug") or debug
 return debugLib and debugLib.traceback and debugLib.traceback(tostring(err), 2) or tostring(err)
local function startRun(source, chunkName, requestedKey, background)
 local loader = requireCapability("loadstring", nativeLoadString)
 local compiled, compileError = loader(tostring(source or ""), tostring(chunkName or "=FlowExecutorMCP"))
 if type(compiled) ~= "function" then error("compile failed: " .. tostring(compileError)) end
 local key = normalizeRunKey(requestedKey)
 if key == nil then
  runRegistry.sequence += 1
  key = "run-" .. runRegistry.sequence
 end
 local replaced = false
 local previous = runRegistry.byKey[key]
 if previous then replaced = stopRun(previous, "replaced") end
 local run = {
  key = key,
  chunkName = tostring(chunkName or "=FlowExecutorMCP"),
  background = background == true,
  alive = true,
  status = "running",
  bodyRunning = true,
  startedAt = os.time(),
  startedClock = os.clock(),
  threads = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
  instances = {},
  instanceCount = 0,
  connections = {},
  cleanups = {},
  tracked = {}
 local tracking = false
 local getEnvironment = nativeLookup("getfenv") or getfenv
 local setEnvironment = nativeLookup("setfenv") or setfenv
 if type(getEnvironment) == "function" and type(setEnvironment) == "function" then
  local okBase, baseEnv = pcall(getEnvironment, compiled)
  if okBase and type(baseEnv) == "table" then
   tracking = pcall(setEnvironment, compiled, makeRunEnvironment(run, baseEnv))
  end
 end
 if not tracking then makeRunEnvironment(run, env) end
 run.tracking = tracking
 runRegistry.byKey[key] = run
 local function finishBody(ok, err)
  run.bodyRunning = false
  if runRegistry.byKey[key] ~= run then return end
  if not ok then
   run.lastError = string.sub(tostring(err), 1, MAX_RUN_ERROR_CHARS)
   run.status = "errored"
  else
   run.status = "active"
  end
  if not runHasLiveResources(run) then
   run.alive = false
   run.api.alive = false
   retireRun(run, ok and "finished" or "errored", nil)
  end
 end
 if run.background then
  local thread = realTask.spawn(function()
   local ok, err = xpcall(compiled, runTraceback)
   finishBody(ok, err)
  end)
  if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then run.threads[thread] = true end
  return {runKey = key, background = true, status = run.status, replaced = replaced, tracking = tracking}
 end
 run.foregroundThread = coroutine.running()
 local packed = table.pack(xpcall(compiled, runTraceback))
 run.foregroundThread = nil
 finishBody(packed[1], packed[2])
 -- Level 0: the message already carries the script's own position and traceback.
 if not packed[1] then error(packed[2], 0) end
 local results, omitted = packRunResults(packed)
 return {results = results, omitted = omitted, runKey = key, status = run.status, replaced = replaced, tracking = tracking}
local function sweepRuns()
 for _, run in next, runRegistry.byKey do
  if run.alive and not runHasLiveResources(run) then
   run.alive = false
   run.api.alive = false
   retireRun(run, run.status == "errored" and "errored" or "finished", nil)
  end
 end
handlers["list-runs"] = function()
 sweepRuns()
 local active = {}
 for _, run in next, runRegistry.byKey do table.insert(active, runSummary(run)) end
 table.sort(active, function(a, b) return a.ageSeconds > b.ageSeconds end)
 return {active = active, recent = runRegistry.recent}
handlers["stop-run"] = function(payload)
 local stopped = {}
 if payload.all == true then
  local runs = {}
  for _, run in next, runRegistry.byKey do table.insert(runs, run) end
  for _, run in ipairs(runs) do
   if stopRun(run, "stop_run") then table.insert(stopped, run.key) end
  end
  return {stopped = stopped}
 end
 local key = normalizeRunKey(payload.runKey)
 if key == nil then error("INVALID_ARGUMENTS:Pass runKey or all=true") end
 local run = runRegistry.byKey[key]
 if run == nil then error("RUN_NOT_FOUND:No active run named " .. key .. "; call list_runs") end
 if stopRun(run, "stop_run") then table.insert(stopped, key) end
 return {stopped = stopped}
handlers["execute"] = function(payload)
 return startRun(payload.source or payload.code, payload.chunkName, payload.runKey, payload.background == true)
handlers["execute-file"] = function(payload)
 local read = requireCapability("readfile", nativeReadFile)
 local path = tostring(payload.path or "")
 return startRun(read(path), "@" .. path, payload.runKey or path, payload.background == true)
-- FLOW_RUNS_END
handlers["get-data-by-code"] = function(payload)
 return runSource(payload.source or payload.code, payload.chunkName)
handlers["get-console-output"] = function(payload)
 consoleCapture.start(payload.captureDurationMs)
 local waitMs = clamp(payload.waitMs, 0, 5000, 0)
 if waitMs > 0 then task.wait(waitMs / 1000) end
 local limit = clamp(payload.limit, 1, 500, 100)
 local filter = string.lower(tostring(payload.filter or ""))
 local newest = {}
 for i = consoleEntries.count, 1, -1 do
  local entry = ringGet(consoleEntries, i)
  if filter == "" or string.find(string.lower(entry.message), filter, 1, true) then
   table.insert(newest, entry)
   if #newest >= limit then break end
  end
 end
 local results = {}
 for i = #newest, 1, -1 do table.insert(results, newest[i]) end
 return results
handlers["clear-console-buffer"] = function()
 ringClear(consoleEntries)
 local captureDurationMs = consoleCapture.start(10000)
 return {cleared = true, captureActive = true, captureDurationMs = captureDurationMs, expiresAt = consoleCapture.expiresAt}
local function configureRemoteSpy(payload)
 local profile = tostring(payload.profile or "balanced")
 if profile ~= "stealth" and profile ~= "balanced" and profile ~= "full" then error("invalid RemoteSpy profile: " .. profile) end
 spyState.profile = profile
 spyState.includeExecutor = payload.includeExecutor == true
 spyState.includeBindables = profile ~= "stealth" and payload.includeBindables == true
 spyState.captureInbound = profile == "full" and payload.captureInbound == true
 spyState.captureCallingScript = profile ~= "stealth" and payload.captureCallingScript == true
 spyState.captureReturnsRequested = profile == "full" and payload.captureReturns == true
 spyState.captureReturns = false
 spyState.captureDirectCallsRequested = payload.captureDirectCalls == true
 spyState.captureDirectCalls = remoteHookPlan(profile, spyState.captureDirectCallsRequested).installMethods
 spyState.lowFootprint = profile == "stealth"
 spyState.methods = nil
 if type(payload.methods) == "table" and #payload.methods > 0 then
  spyState.methods = {}
  for index = 1, math.min(#payload.methods, 16) do spyState.methods[tostring(payload.methods[index])] = true end
 end
local function remoteHookInstalled()
 local hookState = runtime.remoteHooks.namecall
 return type(hookState) == "table" and hookState.version == 5 and hookState.installed == true
local function remoteMethodHooksInstalled()
 local hookState = runtime.remoteHooks.methods
 return type(hookState) == "table" and hookState.version == 3 and hookState.installed == true
local function remoteQueueStatus()
 return {
  depth = spyState.queue.count,
  capacity = spyState.queue.capacity,
  accepted = spyState.queue.accepted,
  processed = spyState.processed,
  dropped = spyState.queue.dropped,
  highWater = spyState.queue.highWater,
  drainScheduled = spyState.drainScheduled,
  workerRuns = spyState.workerRuns,
  activeWorkers = spyState.activeWorkers,
  workerHighWater = spyState.workerHighWater,
  serializationFailures = spyState.serializationFailures,
  serializationBudgetExhaustions = spyState.serializationBudgetExhaustions
local function recordMatchesRemoteFilters(entry, payload)
 if entry.sequence <= math.max(0, tonumber(payload.afterSequence) or 0) then return false end
 if payload.method ~= nil and entry.method ~= tostring(payload.method) then return false end
 if payload.className ~= nil and entry.className ~= tostring(payload.className) then return false end
 if payload.direction ~= nil and entry.direction ~= tostring(payload.direction) then return false end
 if payload.fromExecutor ~= nil and entry.fromExecutor ~= (payload.fromExecutor == true) then return false end
 if payload.handle ~= nil and entry.handle ~= tostring(payload.handle) then return false end
 local pathContains = string.lower(tostring(payload.pathContains or ""))
 if pathContains ~= "" and not string.find(string.lower(tostring(entry.path or "")), pathContains, 1, true) then return false end
 local callingContains = string.lower(tostring(payload.callingScriptContains or ""))
 if callingContains ~= "" then
  local callingPath = type(entry.callingScript) == "table" and entry.callingScript.path or entry.callingScript
  if not string.find(string.lower(tostring(callingPath or "")), callingContains, 1, true) then return false end
 end
 local filter = string.lower(tostring(payload.filter or ""))
 return filter == "" or string.find(string.lower(tostring(entry.key or "")), filter, 1, true) ~= nil
local function parseRemoteRuleKey(key)
 if type(key) ~= "string" then return nil, nil, nil end
 return string.match(key, "^([^|]+)|([^|]+)|(.*)$")
local function defaultRemoteMethod(className)
 if className == "RemoteFunction" then return "InvokeServer" end
 if className == "BindableEvent" then return "Fire" end
 if className == "BindableFunction" then return "Invoke" end
 return "FireServer"
local function resolveRemoteRulePayload(payload)
 local parsedMethod, parsedClass, parsedPath = parseRemoteRuleKey(payload.key)
 local target
 if payload.handle ~= nil then
  target = resolveHandle(payload.handle)
 elseif payload.path ~= nil then
  target = resolveInstance({path = payload.path})
 elseif parsedPath and parsedPath ~= "" then
  target = resolveInstance({path = parsedPath})
 else
  error("a remote rule requires an exact path or handle")
 end
 local className = remoteClassName(target)
 local requestedClass = payload.className or parsedClass
 if requestedClass ~= nil and tostring(requestedClass) ~= className then
  error("remote rule class mismatch: expected " .. tostring(requestedClass) .. ", resolved " .. className)
 end
 local method = tostring(payload.method or parsedMethod or defaultRemoteMethod(className))
 if not outgoingClassAllowed({includeBindables = true, methods = nil}, className, method) then
  error("remote rule method is incompatible with " .. className .. ": " .. method)
 end
 local path = safePath(target)
 return target, method, className, path, remoteRuleKey(method, className, path)
local function mutateRemoteRule(kind, enabled, payload)
 if spyState.profile == "stealth" and enabled then error("RemoteSpy stealth profile does not permit behavior-changing rules") end
 pruneRemoteRules(spyState)
 local records = spyState.rules[kind]
 local index = kind == "blocked" and spyState.blockedByInstance or spyState.ignoredByInstance
 local debugIndex = kind == "blocked" and spyState.blockedByDebugId or spyState.ignoredByDebugId
 if not enabled and type(payload.key) == "string" and payload.handle == nil and payload.path == nil then
  local removed = 0
  for id, record in pairs(records) do
   if record.key == payload.key then
    local target = record.target
    local methods = target and index[target] or nil
    if type(methods) == "table" then
     methods[record.method] = nil
     if next(methods) == nil then index[target] = nil end
    end
    local debugMethods = record.debugId and debugIndex[record.debugId] or nil
    if type(debugMethods) == "table" then
     debugMethods[record.method] = nil
     if next(debugMethods) == nil then debugIndex[record.debugId] = nil end
    end
    records[id] = nil
    removed += 1
   end
  end
  return {key = payload.key, [kind] = false, removed = removed}
 end
 local target, method, className, path, key = resolveRemoteRulePayload(payload)
 local id = method .. "|" .. getHandle(target)
 local debugId = getInstanceDebugId(target)
 local methods = index[target]
 if enabled then
  if records[id] == nil and countEntries(records) >= MAX_REMOTE_RULES then error("RemoteSpy rule limit reached") end
  if type(methods) ~= "table" then methods = {}; index[target] = methods end
  methods[method] = true
  if debugId then
   local debugMethods = debugIndex[debugId]
   if type(debugMethods) ~= "table" then debugMethods = {}; debugIndex[debugId] = debugMethods end
   debugMethods[method] = true
  end
  records[id] = {
   key = key,
   method = method,
   className = className,
   path = path,
   handle = getHandle(target),
   debugId = debugId,
   target = target
 else
  if type(methods) == "table" then
   methods[method] = nil
   if next(methods) == nil then index[target] = nil end
  end
  local debugMethods = debugId and debugIndex[debugId] or nil
  if type(debugMethods) == "table" then
   debugMethods[method] = nil
   if next(debugMethods) == nil then debugIndex[debugId] = nil end
  end
  records[id] = nil
 end
 return {key = key, handle = getHandle(target), [kind] = enabled}
handlers["remote-spy-start"] = function(payload)
 remoteLifecycle.stop("restart")
 configureRemoteSpy(payload)
 local maxLogs = clamp(payload.maxLogs, 10, 1000, MAX_REMOTE_LOGS)
 if maxLogs ~= spyState.maxLogs then spyState.logs = ringResize(spyState.logs, maxLogs) end
 spyState.maxLogs = maxLogs
 local queueCapacity = clamp(payload.queueCapacity, 32, 8192, remoteLimits.defaultQueueCapacity)
 spyState.queueCapacity = queueCapacity
 spyState.queue = newCaptureQueue(queueCapacity)
 runtime.remoteDispatch = invokeCapturedRemote
 runtimeState.resolveInstancePath = resolvePath
 local hookPlan = remoteHookPlan(spyState.profile, spyState.captureDirectCallsRequested)
 local installed, methodHooksInstalled, methodHookCoverage, methodHookErrors = installRemoteSpyHookPlan(
  hookPlan,
  installRemoteHook,
  installRemoteMethodHooks
 spyState.methodHooksInstalled = methodHooksInstalled
 spyState.methodHookCoverage = methodHookCoverage
 spyState.methodHookErrors = methodHookErrors
 spyState.enabled = installed or methodHooksInstalled
 local selfTests = spyState.enabled and runRemoteBackendSelfTest(
  spyState.captureDirectCalls,
  spyState.captureReturnsRequested
 ) or nil
 spyState.captureReturns = spyState.captureReturnsRequested
  and type(spyState.coverage) == "table"
  and spyState.coverage.returns == true
 if spyState.enabled and spyState.captureInbound then startInboundCapture(spyState) end
 local durationMs = clamp(payload.durationMs, 1000, 300000, 15000)
 spyState.durationMs = durationMs
 spyState.leaseGeneration += 1
 local lease = spyState.leaseGeneration
 spyState.expiresAt = os.clock() + durationMs / 1000
 spyState.stopReason = nil

  task.delay(durationMs / 1000, function()

  local ok, name, version = pcall(identify)
  if ok then

   -- connector would then retry registration forever.

  end
 end
 return "Unknown", ""

local function commandError(message)
 local text = truncate(message, MAX_RESULT_STRING)
 local capability = string.match(text, "UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY:([^%s]+)")
 local staleHandle = string.match(text, "STALE_INSTANCE_HANDLE:([^%s]+)")
 return {
  code = capability and "UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY" or staleHandle and "STALE_INSTANCE_HANDLE"
   or string.match(text, "(RUN_NOT_FOUND):") or string.match(text, "(INVALID_RUN_KEY):") or "COMMAND_FAILED",
  message = text,
  details = capability and {missing = capability} or staleHandle and {handle = staleHandle} or nil
local function commandStringLimit(commandType)
 if commandType == "get-script-source" or commandType == "get-script-bytecode" then return 200000 end
 if commandType == "execute" or commandType == "execute-file" or commandType == "get-data-by-code" then return MAX_RESULT_STRING end
 return MAX_SERIALIZE_STRING
local function boundResponse(response)
 local encodedOk, encoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, response)
 if encodedOk and #encoded <= MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES then return response end
 if response.ok then
  response.result = {
   transportTruncated = true,
   originalBytes = encodedOk and #encoded or nil,
   preview = safeValue(response.result, 0, nil, 1000)
 else
  response.error = {
   code = "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE",
   message = encodedOk and "Command response exceeded the bridge limit" or "Command response could not be encoded"
 end
 -- A response that still cannot be encoded is dropped by the /respond retry loop, which the
 -- caller only sees as a COMMAND_TIMEOUT. Send a minimal error so it fails fast and says why.
 if not pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, response) then
  return {
   id = response.id,
   ok = false,
   error = {code = "RESPONSE_ENCODE_FAILED", message = "Command response could not be JSON-encoded"}
 end
 return response
-- FLOW_COMMAND_DEADLINE_BEGIN
local function commandExpired(command, nowMs)
 local deadlineMs = tonumber(type(command) == "table" and command.deadlineMs or nil)
 return deadlineMs ~= nil and deadlineMs > 0 and deadlineMs <= nowMs
-- FLOW_COMMAND_DEADLINE_END
local function currentUnixMilliseconds()
 local nowMs = os.time() * 1000
 pcall(function() nowMs = DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis end)
 return nowMs
local function handleCommand(command)
 local response = {id = tostring(command.id or ""), ok = false}
 if commandExpired(command, currentUnixMilliseconds()) then
  response.error = {code = "COMMAND_EXPIRED", message = "Command deadline passed before executor work began"}
  return response
 end
 local commandType = tostring(command.type or "")
 local handler = handlers[commandType]
 if type(handler) ~= "function" then
  response.error = {code = "UNKNOWN_COMMAND", message = "Unknown connector command: " .. tostring(command.type)}
  return response
 end
 local ok, result = xpcall(function()
  local setIdentity = nativeLookup("setthreadidentity")
  if type(setIdentity) == "function" then pcall(setIdentity, 8) end
  return handler(type(command.payload) == "table" and command.payload or {})
 end, function(err)
  local debugLib = rawget(env, "debug") or debug
  return debugLib and debugLib.traceback and debugLib.traceback(tostring(err), 2) or tostring(err)
 end)
 if ok then
  response.ok = true
   response.result = safeValue(
    result,
    0,
    nil,
    commandStringLimit(commandType),
    {remaining = remoteLimits.responseTotalEntries},
    remoteLimits.responseEntries,
    remoteLimits.responseDepth
   )
 else
  response.error = commandError(result)
 end
 return boundResponse(response)
local stopped = false
-- FLOW_RESPONSE_PRIORITY_BEGIN
local function commandPollWaitMs(configuredWaitMs, lightInFlight, heavyInFlight, queuedResponses)
 -- Executor request() implementations may block Roblox's scheduler while the
 -- server holds a request. Sleep in Luau, never inside the HTTP long poll.
 return 0
local function flushCommandResponses()
 local queue = runtime.commandResponses
 if type(queue) ~= "table" or type(queue.items) ~= "table" then return true end
 while queue.head <= queue.tail do
  local item = queue.items[queue.head]
  if type(item) == "table" then
   if (tonumber(item.nextAttemptAt) or 0) > os.clock() then return false end
   local sent, code, _, sendError = requestJson("POST", "/respond", {
    clientId = item.clientId,
    connectionId = item.connectionId,
    response = item.response
   })
   if not sent then
    item.attempts = (tonumber(item.attempts) or 0) + 1
    status.error = "command response failed: " .. tostring(sendError or "transport failed")
    local permanent = (code >= 400 and code < 500 and code ~= 408 and code ~= 429) or item.attempts >= 5
    if not permanent then
     item.nextAttemptAt = os.clock() + math.min(0.8, 0.05 * (2 ^ (item.attempts - 1)))
     return false
    end
   elseif type(status.error) == "string" and string.find(status.error, "command response failed", 1, true) == 1 then
    -- A delivered response means delivery recovered, so diagnostics stop reporting the old failure.
    status.error = nil
   end
  end
  queue.items[queue.head] = nil
  queue.head += 1
 end
 if queue.head > queue.tail then
  queue.head = 1
  queue.tail = 0
 end
 return true
-- FLOW_RESPONSE_PRIORITY_END
-- FLOW_RUNNING_COMMANDS_BEGIN
local function scheduleCommand(command, heavy)
 if not current() or stopped then return end
 if #runtime.commandPending >= 16 then
  local queue = runtime.commandResponses
  queue.tail += 1
  queue.items[queue.tail] = {clientId = clientId, connectionId = connectionId,
   response = {id = tostring(command.id or ""), ok = false,
    error = {code = "CONNECTOR_BUSY", message = "Connector command queue is full; retry after current work finishes"}}}
  return
 end
 runtime.commandPending[#runtime.commandPending + 1] = {command = command, heavy = heavy,
  clientId = clientId, connectionId = connectionId}
 local function finish(job, response, cancel)
  if job.finished then return end
  job.finished = true
  runtime.commandTasks[job] = nil
  if cancel and job.thread and job.thread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, job.thread) end
  if job.heavy then heavyInFlightCommands = math.max(0, heavyInFlightCommands - 1)
  else lightInFlightCommands = math.max(0, lightInFlightCommands - 1) end
  local now = os.clock()
  recordCommandTiming(job.command.type, job.heavy, now - job.startedAt, response.ok == true, now)
  if current() and not stopped then
   local queue = runtime.commandResponses
   queue.tail += 1
   queue.items[queue.tail] = {clientId = job.clientId, connectionId = job.connectionId, response = response}
  end
 end
 function runtime.pumpCommands()
  local now = os.clock()
  for job in pairs(runtime.commandTasks) do
   if now >= job.deadline then
    performanceStats.commands.timedOut = (performanceStats.commands.timedOut or 0) + 1
    finish(job, {id = tostring(job.command.id or ""), ok = false,
     error = {code = "COMMAND_TIMEOUT", message = "Connector stopped command work at its deadline"}}, true)
   end
  end
  local index = 1
  while index <= #runtime.commandPending do
   local job = runtime.commandPending[index]
   local available = job.heavy and heavyInFlightCommands < MAX_HEAVY_COMMANDS
    or not job.heavy and lightInFlightCommands < MAX_LIGHT_COMMANDS
   if not available then index += 1; continue end
   table.remove(runtime.commandPending, index)
   job.startedAt = os.clock()
   local remainingMs = (tonumber(job.command.deadlineMs) or (currentUnixMilliseconds() + 15000)) - currentUnixMilliseconds()
   job.deadline = job.startedAt + math.clamp(remainingMs / 1000, 0, 120)
   runtime.commandTasks[job] = true
   if job.heavy then
    heavyInFlightCommands += 1
    performanceStats.scheduler.heavyStarted += 1
    performanceStats.scheduler.highWaterHeavy = math.max(performanceStats.scheduler.highWaterHeavy, heavyInFlightCommands)
   else
    lightInFlightCommands += 1
    performanceStats.scheduler.lightStarted += 1
    performanceStats.scheduler.highWaterLight = math.max(performanceStats.scheduler.highWaterLight, lightInFlightCommands)
   end
   job.thread = task.defer(function()
    local ok, response = pcall(handleCommand, job.command)
    if not ok then response = {id = tostring(job.command.id or ""), ok = false, error = commandError(response)} end
    finish(job, response, false)
   end)
  end
 end
 function runtime.cancelCommands()
  table.clear(runtime.commandPending)
  for job in pairs(runtime.commandTasks) do
   finish(job, {id = tostring(job.command.id or ""), ok = false,
    error = {code = "CONNECTOR_STOPPED", message = "Connector stopped or reloaded"}}, true)
  end
  table.clear(runtime.commandResponses.items)
  runtime.commandResponses.head, runtime.commandResponses.tail = 1, 0
 end
-- FLOW_RUNNING_COMMANDS_END
runtimeState.stop = function()
 if not current() then return end
 stopped = true
 runtime.cancelCommands()
 remoteLifecycle.stop("connector-stop")
 consoleCapture.stop()
 for watchId, watcher in pairs(watchers) do
  disconnectWatcher(watcher)
  watchers[watchId] = nil
 end
 runtimeState.loaded = false
 setStatus("stopped")
 if rawget(env, PRIVATE_STATE_KEY) == runtimeState then rawset(env, PRIVATE_STATE_KEY, nil) end
if type(requestFn) ~= "function" then
 setStatus("stopped", "No supported HTTP request function. Tried: " .. table.concat(requestAliasOrder, ", "))
 warn("[FlowExecutorMCP] " .. status.error)
 return
task.spawn(function()
 while current() and not stopped do
  runtime.pumpCommands()
  task.wait((lightInFlightCommands + heavyInFlightCommands > 0 or #runtime.commandPending > 0) and 0.05 or 0.25)
 end
end)
task.spawn(function()
 local backoff = 0.5
 while current() and not stopped do
  if not flushCommandResponses() then
   task.wait(0.05)
   continue
  end
  if not clientId then
   if register() then
    backoff = 0.5
   else
    task.wait(backoff + math.random() * 0.2)
    backoff = math.min(backoff * 1.6, 5)
   end
  else
   local responseQueue = runtime.commandResponses
   local queuedResponses = math.max(0, responseQueue.tail - responseQueue.head + 1)
   local effectivePollWaitMs = commandPollWaitMs(pollWaitMs, lightInFlightCommands, heavyInFlightCommands, queuedResponses)
   if effectivePollWaitMs < pollWaitMs then
    task.wait(0.01)
    flushCommandResponses()
   end
   local path = "/poll?clientId=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(clientId) .. "&connectionId=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(connectionId) .. "&waitMs=" .. tostring(effectivePollWaitMs)
   local ok, code, commands, err = requestJson("GET", path)
   if not ok then
    status.error = tostring(err or "poll failed")
    if code == 400 or code == 401 or code == 404 or code == 409 or code == 0 then
     clientId = nil
     status.clientId = nil
     runtimeState.loaded = false
     setStatus("reconnecting", status.error)
    else
     task.wait(0.5)
    end
   elseif type(commands) == "table" then
    local lightCommands, heavyCommands = partitionCommands(commands)
    for _, command in ipairs(lightCommands) do scheduleCommand(command, false) end
    for _, command in ipairs(heavyCommands) do scheduleCommand(command, true) end
    if #lightCommands > 0 or #heavyCommands > 0 then
     -- Start the work now rather than on the pump loop's next tick, so quick commands are answered by the flush below.
     runtime.pumpCommands()
     task.wait(0.05)
     flushCommandResponses()
    else
     task.wait((lightInFlightCommands + heavyInFlightCommands > 0 or queuedResponses > 0) and 0.1 or 0.5)
    end
   end
  end
 end
end)
task.spawn(function()
 local failures = 0
 while current() and not stopped do
 task.wait(5)
  if clientId and shouldSendHeartbeat(lastTransportActivity, os.clock(), heartbeatIdleSeconds) then
   local ok = requestJson("POST", "/heartbeat", {
    clientId = clientId,
    connectionId = connectionId
   })
   if ok then
    failures = 0
   else
    failures += 1
    if failures >= 3 then
     clientId = nil
     status.clientId = nil
     runtimeState.loaded = false
     setStatus("reconnecting", "heartbeat failed")
     failures = 0
    end
   end
  end
 end
end)

=Multiple Roblox windows are visible; pass a pid. Candidates: 
Windows would not render the Roblox window
originalWidthoriginalHeightpngBytesCould not open the window's device contextThe Roblox window is not responding; wait for it to recoverThe Roblox window is minimized; restore it first\
Flow MCP drives a Roblox client that has Flow injected. Keep results small and accurate:
1. If more than one client may be connected, call list_clients and set_active_client first; tools act on the active client unless you pass clientId.
2. Explore cheaply before going wide: get_instance_tree with a low maxDepth/maxChildren, or search_instances with a tight query, className and limit. Read one instance with get_instance_properties or get_instance_attributes.
3. Find code with search_scripts (names first, includeSource only when needed), then read just the part you need with get_script_source offsetBytes/maxChars. For internals use get_script_environment, get_function_upvalues, get_script_debug_info and get_signal_connections instead of ad-hoc code.
4. execute runs Luau as a tracked run (use `return` for values). Give anything that loops, connects signals or builds UI a runKey: running it again with the same runKey tears down the old run first, so you never stack duplicate loops. Pass background=true for scripts that keep running, then use list_runs to check them and stop_run to end them. Inside a run, use RUN.connect(signal, fn) for connections, RUN.onStop(fn) for cleanup and `while RUN.alive do ... task.wait() end` for loops; task threads and Instance.new instances are cleaned up automatically.
5. get_data_by_code is for small value probes: return compact values, never whole instances or large tables.
6. Prefer the dedicated tools over hand-written code: fire_proximity_prompt, fire_click_detector, fire_touch_interest, click_gui_button and type_text_box for interaction; watch_instance_property for changes over time; remote_spy_start then remote_spy_list with a low limit and filters for network traffic.
7. After execute, verify with get_console_output (low limit, filter) or a targeted probe. screenshot_roblox_window shows what the player sees.
8. When a result is marked oversized, page through it with read_result_chunk rather than re-running with bigger limits.

;(function () {
  /**
   * @type {string}
   */
  const pattern = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.__TAURI_PATTERN__.pattern
  /**
   * @type {string}
   */
  const isolationOrigin = __TEMPLATE_isolation_origin__
  /**
   * @type {{queue: object[], ready: boolean, frame: HTMLElement | null}}
   */
  const isolation = Object.create(null)
  isolation.queue = []
  isolation.ready = false
  isolation.frame = null
  /**
   * Detects if a message event is a valid isolation message.
   *
   * @param {MessageEvent<object>} event - a message event that is expected to be an isolation message
   * @return {boolean} - if the event was a valid isolation message
   */
  function isIsolationMessage(event) {
    if (
      typeof event.data === 'object'
      && typeof event.data.payload === 'object'
    ) {
      const keys = Object.keys(event.data.payload || {})
      return (
        keys.length > 0
        && keys.every(
          (key) => key === 'contentType' || key === 'nonce' || key === 'payload'
        )
      )
    }
    return false
  /**
   * Detects if data is able to transform into an isolation payload.
   *
   * @param {object} data - object that is expected to contain at least a callback and error identifier
   * @return {boolean} - if the data is able to transform into an isolation payload
   */
  function isIsolationPayload(data) {
    return (
      typeof data === 'object'
      && 'callback' in data
      && 'error' in data
      && !isIsolationMessage(data)
    )
  /**
   * Sends a properly formatted message to the isolation frame.
   *
   * @param {IsolationPayload} data - data that has been validated to be an isolation payload
   */
  function sendIsolationMessage(data) {
    // set the frame dom element if it's not been set before
    if (!isolation.frame) {
      const frame = document.querySelector('iframe#__tauri_isolation__')
      if (frame.src.startsWith(isolationOrigin)) {
        isolation.frame = frame
      } else {
        console.error(
          'Tauri IPC found an isolation iframe, but it had the wrong origin'
        )
      }
    }
    // ensure we have the target to send the message to
    if (!isolation.frame || !isolation.frame.contentWindow) {
      console.error(
        'Tauri "Isolation" Pattern could not find the Isolation iframe window'
      )
      return
    }
    // `postMessage` uses `structuredClone` to serialize the data before sending it
    // unlike `JSON.stringify`, we can't extend a type with a method similar to `toJSON`
    // so that `structuredClone` would use, so until https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7428
    // we manually call `toIPC`
    function serializeIpcPayload(data) {
      // if this value changes, make sure to update it in:
      // 1. process-ipc-message-fn.js
      // 2. core.ts
      const SERIALIZE_TO_IPC_FN = '__TAURI_TO_IPC_KEY__'
      if (
        typeof data === 'object'
        && data !== null
        && 'constructor' in data
        && data.constructor === Array
      ) {
        return data.map((v) => serializeIpcPayload(v))
      }
      if (
        typeof data === 'object'
        && data !== null
        && SERIALIZE_TO_IPC_FN in data
      ) {
        return data[SERIALIZE_TO_IPC_FN]()
      }
      if (
        typeof data === 'object'
        && data !== null
        && 'constructor' in data
        && data.constructor === Object
      ) {
        const acc = {}
        Object.entries(data).forEach(([k, v]) => {
          acc[k] = serializeIpcPayload(v)
        })
        return acc
      }
      return data
    }
    data.payload = serializeIpcPayload(data.payload)
    isolation.frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
      data,
      '*' /* todo: set this to the secure origin */
    )
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'ipc', {
    // todo: JSDoc this function
    value: Object.freeze((message) => {
      switch (pattern) {
        case 'brownfield':
          window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.postMessage(message)
          break
        case 'isolation':
          if (!isIsolationPayload(message)) {
            console.error(
              'Tauri "Isolation" Pattern found an invalid isolation message payload',
              message
            )
            break
          }
          if (isolation.ready) {
            sendIsolationMessage(message)
          } else {
            isolation.queue.push(message)
          }
          break
        case 'error':
          console.error(
            'Tauri IPC found a Tauri Pattern, but it was an error. Check for other log messages to find the cause.'
          )
          break
        default:
          console.error(
            'Tauri IPC did not find a Tauri Pattern that it understood.'
          )
          break
      }
    })
  })
  /**
   * IMPORTANT: See isolation_secure.js for the isolation frame implementation.
   * main frame -> isolation frame = isolation payload
   * isolation frame -> main frame = isolation message
   */
  if (pattern === 'isolation') {
    window.addEventListener(
      'message',
      (event) => {
        // watch for the isolation frame being ready and flush any queued messages
        if (event.data === '__TAURI_ISOLATION_READY__') {
          isolation.ready = true
          for (const message of isolation.queue) {
            sendIsolationMessage(message)
          }
          isolation.queue = []
          return
        }
        if (isIsolationMessage(event)) {
          window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.postMessage(event.data)
        }
      },
      false
    )
})()

;(function () {
  function uid() {
    return window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0]
  const osName = __TEMPLATE_os_name__
  const protocolScheme = __TEMPLATE_protocol_scheme__
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'convertFileSrc', {
    value: function (filePath, protocol = 'asset') {
      const path = encodeURIComponent(filePath)
      return osName === 'windows' || osName === 'android'
        ? `${protocolScheme}://${protocol}.localhost/${path}`
        : `${protocol}://localhost/${path}`
    }
  })
  const callbacks = new Map()
  function registerCallback(callback, once) {
    const identifier = uid()
    callbacks.set(identifier, (data) => {
      if (once) {
        unregisterCallback(identifier)
      }
      return callback && callback(data)
    })
    return identifier
  function unregisterCallback(id) {
    callbacks.delete(id)
  function runCallback(id, data) {
    const callback = callbacks.get(id)
    if (callback) {
      callback(data)
    } else {
      console.warn(
        `[TAURI] Couldn't find callback id ${id}. This might happen when the app is reloaded while Rust is running an asynchronous operation.`
      )
    }
  // Maybe let's rename it to `registerCallback`?
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'transformCallback', {
    value: registerCallback
  })
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'unregisterCallback', {
    value: unregisterCallback
  })
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'runCallback', {
    value: runCallback
  })
  // This is just for the debugging purposes
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'callbacks', {
    value: callbacks
  })
  const ipcQueue = []
  let isWaitingForIpc = false
  function waitForIpc() {
    if ('ipc' in window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__) {
      for (const action of ipcQueue) {
        action()
      }
    } else {
      setTimeout(waitForIpc, 50)
    }
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'invoke', {
    value: function (cmd, payload = {}, options) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        const callback = registerCallback((r) => {
          resolve(r)
          unregisterCallback(error)
        }, true)
        const error = registerCallback((e) => {
          reject(e)
          unregisterCallback(callback)
        }, true)
        const action = () => {
          window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.ipc({
            cmd,
            callback,
            error,
            payload,
            options
          })
        }
        if ('ipc' in window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__) {
          action()
        } else {
          ipcQueue.push(action)
          if (!isWaitingForIpc) {
            waitForIpc()
            isWaitingForIpc = true
          }
        }
      })
    }
  })

;(function () {
  //-----------------------//
  // drag on mousedown and maximize on double click on Windows and Linux
  // while macOS maximization should be on mouseup and if the mouse
  // moves after the double click, it should be cancelled (see https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/8306)
  //-----------------------//
  const TAURI_DRAG_REGION_ATTR = 'data-tauri-drag-region'
  const CLICKABLE_TAGS = new Set([
    'A',
    'BUTTON',
    'INPUT',
    'SELECT',
    'TEXTAREA',
    'LABEL',
    'SUMMARY'
  ])
  const INTERACTIVE_ROLES = new Set([
    'button',
    'link',
    'menuitem',
    'tab',
    'checkbox',
    'radio',
    'switch',
    'option'
  ])
  function isClickableElement(el) {
    return (
      CLICKABLE_TAGS.has(el.tagName)
      || (el.hasAttribute('contenteditable')
        && el.getAttribute('contenteditable') !== 'false')
      || (el.hasAttribute('tabindex') && el.getAttribute('tabindex') !== '-1')
      || INTERACTIVE_ROLES.has(el.getAttribute('role'))
    )
  // Walk the composed path from target upward.
  //
  // Supported values for data-tauri-drag-region:
  //   (bare / no value / "true") -> self: only direct clicks on this element trigger drag
  //   "deep"                   -> deep: clicks anywhere in the subtree trigger drag
  //   "false"                  -> disabled: drag is blocked here (and for ancestors)
  //
  // Clickable elements (buttons, links, etc.) normally block dragging,
  // but if they themselves carry data-tauri-drag-region they act as drag regions.
  function isDragRegion(composedPath) {
    for (const el of composedPath) {
      if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) continue
      const attr = el.getAttribute(TAURI_DRAG_REGION_ATTR)
      // clickable without explicit drag region 
 blocks drag
      if (isClickableElement(el) && attr === null) return false
      // no attr 
 keep walking up
      if (attr === null) continue
      // explicitly disabled
      if (attr === 'false') return false
      // subtree drag 
 any descendant triggers
      if (attr === 'deep') return true
      // bare or "true" attr 
 only direct clicks on this element
      if (attr === '' || attr === 'true') return el === composedPath[0]
    }
    return false
  const osName = __TEMPLATE_os_name__
  // initial mousedown position for macOS
  let initialX = 0
  let initialY = 0
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if (
      // was left mouse button
      e.button === 0
      // and was normal click to drag or double click to maximize
      && (e.detail === 1 || e.detail === 2)
      // and is drag region
      && isDragRegion(e.composedPath())
    ) {
      // macOS maximization happens on `mouseup`,
      // so we save needed state and early return
      if (osName === 'macos' && e.detail === 2) {
        initialX = e.clientX
        initialY = e.clientY
        return
      }
      // prevents text cursor
      e.preventDefault()
      // fix #2549: double click on drag region edge causes content to maximize without window sizing change
      // https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/2549#issuecomment-1250036908
      e.stopImmediatePropagation()
      // start dragging if the element has a `tauri-drag-region` data attribute and maximize on double-clicking it
      const cmd = e.detail === 2 ? 'internal_toggle_maximize' : 'start_dragging'
      window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('plugin:window|' + cmd)
    }
  })
  // on macOS we maximize on mouseup instead, to match the system behavior where maximization can be canceled
  // if the mouse moves outside the data-tauri-drag-region
  if (osName === 'macos') {
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) => {
      if (
        // was left mouse button
        e.button === 0
        // and was double click
        && e.detail === 2
        // and the cursor hasn't moved from initial mousedown
        && e.clientX === initialX
        && e.clientY === initialY
        // and the event path contains a drag region (with no clickable element in between)
        && isDragRegion(e.composedPath())
      ) {
        window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke(
          'plugin:window|internal_toggle_maximize'
        )
      }
    })
})()

(function (message) {
  if (
    message instanceof ArrayBuffer
    || ArrayBuffer.isView(message)
    || Array.isArray(message)
  ) {
    return {
      contentType: 'application/octet-stream',
      data: message
    }
  } else {
    const data = JSON.stringify(message, (_k, val) => {
      // if this value changes, make sure to update it in:
      // 1. ipc.js
      // 2. core.ts
      const SERIALIZE_TO_IPC_FN = '__TAURI_TO_IPC_KEY__'
      if (val instanceof Map) {
        return Object.fromEntries(val.entries())
      } else if (val instanceof Uint8Array) {
        return Array.from(val)
      } else if (val instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
        return Array.from(new Uint8Array(val))
      } else if (
        typeof val === 'object'
        && val !== null
        && SERIALIZE_TO_IPC_FN in val
      ) {
        return val[SERIALIZE_TO_IPC_FN]()
      } else {
        return val
      }
    })
    return {
      contentType: 'application/json',
      data
    }

;(function () {
  /**
   * A runtime generated key to ensure an IPC call comes from an initialized frame.
   *
   * This is declared outside the `window.__TAURI_INVOKE__` definition to prevent
   * the key from being leaked by `window.__TAURI_INVOKE__.toString()`.
   */
  const __TAURI_INVOKE_KEY__ = __TEMPLATE_invoke_key__
  const processIpcMessage = __RAW_process_ipc_message_fn__
  const osName = __TEMPLATE_os_name__
  const fetchChannelDataCommand = __TEMPLATE_fetch_channel_data_command__
  let customProtocolIpcFailed = false
  // on Android we never use it because Android does not have support to reading the request body
  const canUseCustomProtocol = osName !== 'android'
  function sendIpcMessage(message) {
    const { cmd, callback, error, payload, options } = message
    if (
      !customProtocolIpcFailed
      && (canUseCustomProtocol || cmd === fetchChannelDataCommand)
    ) {
      const { contentType, data } = processIpcMessage(payload)
      const headers = new Headers((options && options.headers) || {})
      headers.set('Content-Type', contentType)
      headers.set('Tauri-Callback', callback)
      headers.set('Tauri-Error', error)
      headers.set('Tauri-Invoke-Key', __TAURI_INVOKE_KEY__)
      fetch(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.convertFileSrc(cmd, 'ipc'), {
        method: 'POST',
        body: data,
        headers
      })
        .then((response) => {
          const callbackId =
            response.headers.get('Tauri-Response') === 'ok' ? callback : error
          // we need to split here because on Android the content-type gets duplicated
          switch ((response.headers.get('content-type') || '').split(',')[0]) {
            case 'application/json':
              return response.json().then((r) => [callbackId, r])
            case 'text/plain':
              return response.text().then((r) => [callbackId, r])
            default:
              return response.arrayBuffer().then((r) => [callbackId, r])
          }
        })
        .then(
          ([callbackId, data]) => {
            window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.runCallback(callbackId, data)
          },
          (e) => {
            console.warn(
              'IPC custom protocol failed, Tauri will now use the postMessage interface instead',
              e
            )
            // failed to use the custom protocol IPC (either the webview blocked a custom protocol or it was a CSP error)
            // so we need to fallback to the postMessage interface
            customProtocolIpcFailed = true
            sendIpcMessage(message)
          }
        )
    } else {
      // otherwise use the postMessage interface
      const { data } = processIpcMessage({
        cmd,
        callback,
        error,
        options: {
          ...options,
          customProtocolIpcBlocked: customProtocolIpcFailed
        },
        payload,
        __TAURI_INVOKE_KEY__
      })
      // `window.ipc.postMessage` came from `tauri-runtime-wry` > `wry` [`with_ipc_handler`](https://github.com/tauri-apps/wry/blob/a0403b9e2f1ff9d73be7dce1184f058afcaa1d82/src/lib.rs#L1130)
      window.ipc.postMessage(data)
    }
  Object.defineProperty(window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__, 'postMessage', {
    value: sendIpcMessage
  })
})()
